title: Clinical Data Manager RWD/RWE
description:
À propos de Lifen

Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales peuvent transformer le système de santé, à condition qu’elles soient accessibles. Mieux les faire circuler, c’est réduire la charge administrative, mieux coordonner les soins et accélérer la recherche clinique.

Depuis 2015, nous développons des solutions qui aident les professionnels de santé à partager les informations médicales et les chercheurs à exploiter des données de santé. Plus de 150 personnes travaillent chez Lifen, depuis nos bureaux et à distance. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé en France.

Notre équipe

L’équipe Clinical Ops intervient au cœur de nos projets de recherche clinique fondés sur des données de santé. Elle transforme des documents médicaux en données structurées, nécessaires à la constitution de cohortes patients et à la préparation des exports utilisés dans nos projets de recherche.

Aujourd’hui, l’équipe structure environ 100 à 200 cas patients par semaine . Notre ambition : tripler cette capacité dans les 9 prochains mois, tout en maintenant un haut niveau de qualité des données.

Pour y parvenir, nous cherchons une personne capable de reprendre le management de l’équipe, mais surtout de piloter le flux de production, d’anticiper la charge et de porter une démarche d’amélioration continue avec les équipes Produit, IA et Engineering.

C’est un rôle à la croisée du management opérationnel, de la RWD et de l’amélioration de processus .

Ce que tu feras chez nous

Ta première mission sera de reprendre le pilotage de la production des cohortes afin d’en améliorer simultanément la qualité, la capacité de traitement et le niveau d’automatisation .

Concrètement, tu seras amené·e à :

- Manager et faire grandir l’équipe Clinical Ops, en donnant un cadre clair aux priorités et en organisant l’activité quotidienne.

- Anticiper la charge et piloter la capacité de production afin de limiter les bottlenecks et de mieux absorber les variations de volume.

- Construire les outils de pilotage nécessaires pour avoir une vision fine du flux : volumes de patients, capacité de traitement, taux d’erreur, points de blocage et charge de l’équipe.

- Construire et orchestrer une roadmap d’amélioration continue permettant progressivement d’augmenter la capacité de traitement.

- Porter cette roadmap auprès des équipes Produit, IA et Engineering : rendre les besoins opérationnels visibles, suivre les livrables R&D et créer le rythme nécessaire pour que les améliorations soient effectivement délivrées.

- Garantir la qualité des cohortes et contribuer à la préparation des exports de données nécessaires aux projets de recherche.

Ce que nous attendrons de toi

Dans les premiers mois, nous attendrons de toi que tu développes une compréhension très fine du flux Clinical Ops : où se trouvent les blocages, comment évolue la charge et quels leviers permettent réellement d'améliorer la production.

Ton succès se mesurera notamment à ta capacité à mettre en place un pilotage fiable de l’activité, à réduire les erreurs et les bottlenecks et à créer, avec les équipes Produit et R&D, un rythme d’amélioration continue suffisamment soutenu pour accompagner notre changement d’échelle.

À horizon 9 mois, l’objectif est clair : passer d’environ 100–200 à 300–600 cas patients structurés par semaine, sans multiplier les ressources par trois. 

Ce que nous recherchons

Must-have

Nous chercherons en priorité trois éléments dans ton parcours :

- Une expérience réussie en startup ou scale-up , dans un environnement où les process, outils et responsabilités restaient à construire.

- Une expérience concrète de la Real-World Data / Real-World Evidence , idéalement autour de la constitution ou de l'exploitation de cohortes patients.

- Un background santé ou scientifique te permettant de comprendre les enjeux liés aux données médicales et à la recherche clinique.

Nous attendons également :

- Une expérience confirmée de management d’équipe opérationnelle .

- Une expérience de structuration et de pilotage d’une activité complexe à partir de données et de KPI.

- Une capacité à passer d’un problème opérationnel très concret à un plan d’amélioration structuré.

- Une expérience de collaboration étroite avec des équipes Produit, Data/IA ou Engineering .

- Une capacité à faire avancer une roadmap transverse et à créer de l’accountability autour des livrables.

Nice-to-have

- Un parcours en data management, biostatistiques, épidémiologie ou dans un domaine scientifique proche.

- Une expérience de structuration de registres, bases de données de santé ou cohortes RWD.

- Une familiarité avec les enjeux de recherche clinique et les interactions avec les autorités de santé.

- Une bonne compréhension des usages de l’IA et de l’ingénierie appliqués aux données de santé.

Ta manière de travailler

Tu as une vraie “just do it mentality” : face à un problème imparfaitement cadré, tu commences par comprendre les faits, tu structures le problème et tu mets rapidement en place les premières solutions.

Tu es particulièrement à l’aise dans les environnements où il faut créer les outils plutôt que simplement les utiliser. Si le dashboard dont tu as besoin pour piloter ton équipe n’existe pas, tu es capable de le définir et de le mettre en place.

Tu es structuré·e et organisé·e, mais pas bureaucratique. Tu sais entrer suffisamment dans le détail du flux pour comprendre les problèmes réels, tout en gardant une vision d’ensemble et en priorisant ce qui aura le plus d’impact.

Enfin, tu sais faire avancer des équipes sur lesquelles tu n’as pas nécessairement d’autorité hiérarchique. Tu rends les problèmes visibles, explicites les priorités et crées le rythme nécessaire pour transformer les décisions en améliorations concrètes.

Nos valeurs

Embrace Complexity — Tu aimes comprendre un flux de données complexe, en identifier les points de rupture et transformer cette complexité en décisions concrètes.

Bienveillance — Tu accompagnes une équipe au quotidien avec exigence, écoute et clarté.

Real Impact — Tu améliores la qualité et la disponibilité des données qui permettent de faire avancer des projets de recherche clinique.

Process de recrutement

Échange de préqualification avec Laura, Talent Acquisition Manager, 30 minutes. Nous faisons connaissance, revenons sur ton parcours, tes attentes et les grandes lignes du poste. C’est aussi le moment de répondre à tes premières questions sur Lifen, l’équipe et le contexte.

Entretien avec le VP Reasearch, 60 minutes. Nous revenons plus en détail sur ton parcours, ton expérience en RWD et en constitution de cohortes, ainsi que sur ton expérience de management et de pilotage d’activités opérationnelles. L’objectif est aussi de comprendre la manière dont tu structures et fais évoluer une organisation dans un environnement en croissance.

Use Case avec des membres des équipes Clinical Ops et Produit, 60 minutes. À partir de situations concrètes, nous échangeons sur ta manière de structurer une cohorte RWD, d’analyser des problématiques opérationnelles et de construire des plans d’amélioration. Ce sera également l’occasion d’aborder la manière dont tu gères les enjeux humains et la collaboration avec des équipes transverses.

Cultural alignment avec deux membres de Lifen, 45 minutes en visio. Ce temps permettra d’échanger sur ta façon de travailler, ton niveau d’autonomie, la collaboration au quotidien et l’adéquation avec nos valeurs.

Compensation: €65K – €75K

Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US. 

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us! 

🦾 Our Offer Operations team 

Joko helps millions of users earn cashback automatically, whether they shop online through affiliate links, activate coupons, or pay in-store with their linked bank card. Behind each of these experiences, there's an operational engine that needs to work flawlessly: transactions must be tracked, cashback must be caught, offers must be reliable, and merchants must perform as expected. When this engine breaks, users don't get paid — and trust erodes fast.

Offer Operations owns that engine. The team's mission is to guarantee the reliability and continuous improvement of Joko's core monetization mechanics — across affiliate tracking, coupons, card-linked bank integrations, gift cards, and merchant performance. It's a technical, data-heavy, high-stakes scope that sits right at the heart of what makes Joko's product work.

🎯 What you will do 

As an Operations Manager, your main mission is to own one of the processes that decides whether millions of Joko users actually get the cashback they're owed. You'll report to David Le Pahun , our Offer Operations Lead. The role blends four things: analysing data, designing how the process should work, solving problems with AI, technologies or in the last resort outsourcing, and managing projects.

- Analyse data. You'll build the dashboards that tell you — and everyone else — whether your part of the system is healthy: how many transactions are being correctly tracked and rewarded, what's silently breaking down, whether user experience is suffering.

- Design the process. You decide how merchants get set up on our platform: their cashback rate, which purchases qualify, how we connect to their systems. A lot of this doesn't have a playbook yet — you'll be writing a good chunk of it as you go.

- Solve problems with technology. A merchant might be showing users a coupon that doesn't actually pay out. A batch of card purchases might not match cleanly to any merchant we track. You'll dig into why, then fix it choosing the right solution for it: automating it with AI, improving one of our internal tools (built on Retool) and if a human is required, you'll build the right playbook to outsource it.

- Manage outsourced resources. You'll manage the outsourced team members who help you operate at scale — briefing them, training them, checking their work is actually good — while juggling several of these issues at once and deciding what matters most.

- Partner cross-functionally. With Product & Engineering when the fix is structural, and with the commercial team when it's really about a merchant relationship.

👀 Who we're looking for 

- Experience: around 2–5 years of experience, ideally with exposure to Operations, Product, or a technical/data-driven environment.

- AI-native: you genuinely believe in what AI can do, and you already use it as part of how you work — not as a buzzword, but as a real way to automate the repetitive parts of your job and move faster on the rest.

- Ops mindset: you think in systems — monitoring → detection → investigation → resolution → prevention. You instinctively look for what can break and build safeguards so it doesn't happen again.

- Tech acumen: you're comfortable in a technical environment — tracking, APIs, integrations — and can hold your own in a conversation with Engineering.

- Analytical skills: you're data-driven and comfortable navigating dashboards, investigating anomalies, and making decisions based on metrics.

- Attention to detail: the devil is in the details, and you have a talent for spotting flaws where others don't.

- Communication: clear written and verbal communication skills; you're not afraid to defend your decisions with demanding stakeholders (including merchants and the outsourced teams you'll be directing).

- Education: Top-tier engineering or business school background. International experience and a double degree are a clear plus.

- Languages: fluent in written and spoken English. Mastering French is not required.

💎 Our perks 

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only) 

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

- Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

- Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

- 💸 Top-market compensation

- 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

- 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

- 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

- 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

- 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

- …and much more, check the full list here !

🤝 Our hiring process 

- Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

- Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

- Step 2 – Role-specific assessments 

- For non-engineering roles : A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

- For engineering roles : A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

- Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

title: Endear - Product Designer
description:
Location: Remote, US-based
Team: Product & Design — IRL
Type: Full-Time, Employee
Compensation: $100K–$129K base
Target Start: January 2027 or earlier

Our Story 

At Endear, we’re building the modern CRM for retail teams — starting with the frontline.

Our software helps retail teams build stronger customer relationships through thoughtful, intuitive technology. From clienteling and customer capture to appointments and in-store experiences, Endear gives brands the tools they need to create more personal interactions and drive measurable growth.

We work with brands like Allbirds, Reformation, and Alo Yoga, and we’re continuing to evolve Endear into an increasingly AI-first product built around how modern retail teams actually work.

Position Overview 

We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our IRL (in real life) team, which owns the in-store side of Endear — including appointments, events, customer check-ins, and the administrative experiences behind those workflows.

You’ll design for store associates and managers running clienteling day to day, as well as admin users who help shape how those teams operate and manage their workflows.

In this role, you’ll own features and projects from understanding the problem through research, testing, iteration, and production-ready design, while partnering closely with our Head of Product Design on vision and direction.

The IRL roadmap is early. Many of these features don’t exist yet, so you’ll be defining problems through research before designing solutions.

This role is well suited for someone comfortable creating clarity when the solution isn’t obvious.

What You’ll Accomplish 

In your first 6 months, you’ll… 

- Take ownership of IRL features from discovery through production-ready design

- Build a strong understanding of how store associates, managers, and admin users work within Endear

- Run research from early discovery through usability testing

- Design complete, accessible product experiences, including loading, empty, error, permission, and other key states.

- Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape solutions early in the process

- Use customer insight and data to inform design decisions and iteration

In your first year, you’ll… 

- Build deeper ownership across the IRL product

- Deliver product experiences that improve how retail teams manage clienteling and in-store workflows

- Build a strong rhythm of discovery, testing, and continuous learning

- Strengthen your collaboration across Design, Product, and Engineering

- Demonstrate clear user and business impact through the work you ship

You’ll Thrive in This Role If… 

- You enjoy taking ownership of a feature while collaborating closely on the broader vision and direction

- You’re comfortable with ambiguity and zero-to-one product work

- You naturally think beyond the happy path and account for edge cases and complete product states

- You care about creating accessible experiences and solving the right problem, not just creating polished UI

- You enjoy working closely with Product and Engineering throughout the design process

- You’re comfortable using research, data, and customer feedback to guide decisions

- You move quickly, seek feedback, and iterate based on what you learn

- You’re curious about designing for AI

You Have Experience With 

- 2–5 years working in product design

- Independently owning features from discovery through implementation, with support on vision and direction

- Running user research from discovery through usability testing

- Translating broad or ambiguous problems into clear product solutions

- Working closely with Design, Product, and Engineering teams

- Designing complex, accessible workflows and accounting for loading, empty, error, and permission states

- Using qualitative and quantitative data to inform design decisions

- Building within established design patterns while knowing when something needs to evolve

- Using AI tools as part of your workflow and applying judgment to AI-generated output

- A portfolio that demonstrates strong product thinking and execution, and where you can articulate the impact of your work, with data where you had access to it

Align With What We Value 

At Endear, we live by five core principles. Here’s how they translate into what we’re looking for in this role:

- Customer First: You start by understanding the people using the product, run thoughtful research, and use what you learn to shape better experiences.

- Take Ownership: You take responsibility for your features, follow through on the details, and care about the quality of what ships.

- Enable Autonomy: You communicate clearly, collaborate early, and give Product and Engineering the context they need to make strong decisions together.

- Under Promise, Over Deliver: You set realistic expectations, think through the details, and deliver complete, production-ready work.

- Innovate & Deliver Value Quickly: You’re comfortable experimenting, using AI and other tools thoughtfully, and moving quickly without sacrificing sound product judgment.

About the Team 

Endear’s product organization is structured across three product teams: AI, IRL, and Core Flows, with one designer dedicated to each.

As the IRL designer, you’ll work closely with a Product Manager and 2–3 Engineers while also being part of Endear’s three-person design team. You’ll report to the Head of Product Design, who will provide vision, direction, mentorship, and support as you grow in the role.

You’ll partner most closely with:

- Head of Product Design: vision, direction, mentorship, feedback, and design leadership

- Product Team: roadmap alignment, priorities, customer needs, and business context

- Engineering Team: feasibility, implementation, and iteration

You’ll have access to mentorship, an education budget, and support around Endear’s AI processes to help you continue developing your craft and expanding how you use AI in your work.

We’re a small team with big ambitions — collaborative, customer-obsessed, and deeply excited about the problems we’re solving in retail.

Our Hiring Process 

- Recruiter Screen

- Behavioral Interview with the Hiring Manager

- Team Portfolio Review with Design, Product + Engineering

- Final leadership conversation

- Offer 🎉

Compensation & Benefits 

- Base Salary: $100K–$129K

- Fully remote, US-based team

- Comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental, vision)

- Co-working or home office stipend

- Flexible PTO and unlimited vacation

- Education and learning support

- Opportunity to shape foundational product work in a transformative industry

Location: This role is remote and US-based. Our full team comes together for an all-team standup every Monday at 8:00 AM Pacific, so you’ll need to be available at that time.

Apply Even If You Don’t Check Every Box 

If this role excites you but you’re unsure if you meet every requirement, reach out anyway. No retail or e-commerce background is required. We care about your product thinking, skills, motivation, and how you approach problems more than we do about perfect resumes.

title: Security Engineer Intern
description:
About the role 

Our Security team protects Swile's products, data and engineering platform. We work with a simple principle: when something is recurring, we automate it, and when a security requirement can become code, we write the code.

As a Security Engineer Intern, you will not shadow the team, you will be part of it. You will handle real alerts, run your own audits and own projects end to end, with a dedicated mentor in the team throughout your internship.

What you will do 

Detection and response 

- Handle day to day security alerts: triage, investigate, qualify, escalate when needed.

- Improve what we detect: reduce noise, close detection gaps, propose new signals.

- Automate the recurring: when an alert or a manual check keeps coming back, script it away. This is where we expect you to leave a mark.

Security audits 

- Run targeted audits, from a few days to a few weeks, on applications, configurations or third party providers.

- Turn findings into a prioritised remediation plan rather than a list of tickets.

Projects you will own 

- Ad hoc security projects across the engineering platform.

- Security review and hardening of the tools and integrations we rely on (Dust, third party providers, internal integrations).

Fraud 

- Support fraud investigations: dig, follow the trail, understand how an abuse pattern works and how we could detect it earlier.

What we are looking for 

This is an internship, so how you think matters more than what you already know.

- You learn fast and you are genuinely curious about security.

- You are a doer: you answer quickly, you close loops, you do not let things sit.

- You are pragmatic: you calibrate your response to the actual level of urgency and risk, and you know that not everything is a P1.

- You are open minded and comfortable asking questions across engineering teams.

- You are comfortable working in English, written and spoken.

- You have some scripting ability (Python or equivalent) and a basic understanding of web applications, APIs and cloud environments.

Nice to have that would make you stand out 

- Personal projects, CTFs, homelab, bug bounty or security writeups.

- First exposure to a SIEM, to detection rules or to log analysis at scale.

- Curiosity for fraud and abuse patterns in a financial product.

What this internship is not 

- Not a pure GRC, compliance or policy writing internship.

- Not a pentest internship.

- Not a role where you watch dashboards without changing them.

Practical details

title: CENTRALE LYON - Postdoctoral Researcher Position Deep Learning for Functional-Oxide Growth Video-to-Spectrum Prediction by RHEED / XRD Fusion
description:
PROJECT OVERVIEW 

We are looking for a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to develop innovative deeplearning models that predict the structure of functional-oxide thin films directly from their growth dynamics. Positioned at the interface between Artificial Intelligence and materials physics, the OXYD-IA project aims to design a deep model able to predict the final X-ray Diffraction (XRD) spectrum of an oxide thin film from the sole Reflection High-Energy Electron Diffraction (RHEED) video recorded during its growth by Molecular Beam Epitaxy (MBE). 

The resulting tool will open the way to predictive, in situ control of oxide epitaxy – a process today dominated by a costly trial-and-error approach, in which the structural and functional properties of the films are only validated ex situ. You will join a genuinely multidisciplinary collaboration between the INL (Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon), which provides the operando experimental data and materials-physics expertise, and the LIRIS (équipe Imagine), which provides the deep video-learning and probabilistic-modelling methodology – both at École Centrale de Lyon. 

A high-impact opportunity. AI for experimental physics is a fast-growing field, and OXYD-IA offers a genuine first-mover advantage within it: you would work on a unique, unpublished dataset of paired RHEED videos and XRD spectra to build one of the first video-to-spectrum models with calibrated uncertainty for oxide growth. By learning directly from experimental 1 data, such a model can short-circuit the traditional trial-and-error loop, accelerate discovery and drastically cut experimental time, cost, precursor consumption and instrument occupancy – turning routine in situ diagnostics into predictive tools. 

Scientific context. Epitaxial perovskite-oxide thin films exhibit rich, tunable functional properties (thermoelectricity, ferroelectricity, piezoelectricity) governed by their structure and composition, themselves correlated with the growth conditions. MBE offers independent control of each element but, applied to oxides, is notoriously unstable and poorly reproducible because of the oxidising atmosphere. RHEED tracks the surface dynamics in real time (lattice parameter, surface reconstructions, roughness) but does not give access to the final bulk microstructure, which is only reachable ex situ via XRD / XRR. There is therefore a strong physical link – so far unexploited quantitatively – between RHEED dynamics and final XRD microstructure, which OXYD-IA proposes to learn directly.

Figure 1 – OXYD-IA pipeline. At inference, the RHEED video acquired during growth (INL) feeds a deep video encoder (LIRIS) and a probabilistic regression module that predicts the final XRD spectrum together with its uncertainty. During training, the predicted spectrum is compared with the ex situ XRD / XRR spectrum measured at INL (ground truth); this discrepancy is the supervised learning signal that adjusts the model parameters.

KEY RESEARCH AREAS AND RESPONSIBILITIES 

You will drive the core computational research along a risk-managed, phased 12-month roadmap. The primary target is a versioned RHEED / XRD dataset, growth-regime classification and probabilistic regression of the key structural parameters with calibrated uncertainty; full-spectrum prediction, a real-time demonstrator and cross-oxide generalisation are stretch and follow-on objectives. The work is organised around three technical pillars: 

1. Corpus structuring and spatio-temporal RHEED representation • Build a versioned dataset by cleaning, temporally aligning and pairing the RHEED video sequences, the associated MBE parameters (temperature, oxygen pressure, source fluxes) and the ex situ XRD / XRR spectra (SrTiO3 reference system). • Pre-train, in a self-supervised manner, a spatio-temporal video encoder (3D CNN, e.g. R(2+1)D, or temporal Vision Transformer) fine-tuned on the laboratory corpus. • Perform fuzzy / Bayesian classification of the growth regimes (2D vs. 3D modes, transitions, RHEED oscillations), building on LIRIS expertise in the statistical analysis of sequences. 

2. Probabilistic RHEED →XRD regression with uncertainty quantification • Design a latent representation that couples the video encoding with the physical MBE parameters. • Learn stepwise – first scalar structural parameters (lattice parameter, density, mosaicity), more robust at small N, then the full 1D XRD spectrum. • Provide calibrated uncertainty estimates (Bayesian approaches or deep ensembles), indispensable for guiding real-time decisions during growth. 

3. Real-time demonstrator and dissemination (stretch / follow-on) • Validate the model on new SrTiO3 growths and prototype an in-growth inference tool at the end of the NANOFUTUR MBE line. • Mitigate the small-data and generalisation challenges through temporal data augmentation, transfer learning from pre-trained video encoders and domain adaptation towards other functional oxides. • Contribute toward a high-impact joint publication at the AI / materials interface (the project milestone is the submission of a joint paper).

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 

• A Ph.D. in the field of Artificial Intelligence – Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision or Signal Processing, and we are looking for a senior postdoc with 2–5 years of post-PhD experience. 

• Deep learning on sequential / video data: demonstrable, hands-on experience with 3D CNNs, temporal transformers and / or probabilistic models. Proficiency in Python and PyTorch (or TensorFlow) is mandatory. 

• A genuine appetite for physics: a strong curiosity for, or prior exposure to, experimental physics and materials science. The ideal candidate carried out an AI-focused Ph.D. and is eager to apply it to a real materials-physics problem. 

• Research mindset: a track record of innovation and the ability to work autonomously on a complex, multidisciplinary project. • Software skills: experience with Git version control and reproducible research. 

• Excellent communication and scientific-writing skills in English. 

ADDITIONAL SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES 

• Self-supervised video pre-training, uncertainty quantification (Bayesian / ensembles), fuzzy classification, or domain adaptation. 

• Experience with small-sample / transfer-learning settings and handling large-scale experimental datasets.

HOW TO APPLY 

Please prepare a single PDF file containing: 

1. A detailed Curriculum Vitae, including a list of publications. 

2. A 1-page motivation letter explaining your specific interest in this project and how your background addresses the key responsibilities and qualifications listed above. 

3. The names and contact information of at least two academic references.

title: Engineering Manager (m/w/d) – Core Team
description:
Deine Aufgaben Wir bauen die Software, mit der Mieterstromprojekte laufen: Zählerdaten rein, Abrechnung raus, und alles dazwischen. Das Core Team verantwortet das Betreiberportal, das Produkt, auf dem der laufende Betrieb unserer Kunden steht. Es ist unser fachlich tiefstes Team, und es wächst. 

Das Betreiberportal ist kein generisches SaaS. Es bildet die Energiewirtschaft ab: Messstellenbetrieb, Marktkommunikation, Netzentgelte, Umlagen, Abrechnung nach Regeln, die der Gesetzgeber schreibt und regelmäßig ändert. Wer hier priorisiert, muss verstehen, was eine Anforderung für den Betreiber wirtschaftlich bedeutet und was passiert, wenn sie falsch umgesetzt wird. 

Dafür suchen wir eine Person, die das Team führt und das Geschäft dahinter versteht. Nicht als Durchreiche für Tickets und nicht als Architekt, der alles selbst entscheidet, sondern als jemand, der Business-Anforderungen in technische Entscheidungen übersetzt und dafür sorgt, dass gute Entwickler gute Arbeit machen können: klare Ziele, wenig Reibung, ehrliches Feedback, verlässliche Lieferung. 

Der Weg dahin ist bewusst gewählt: Du startest für rund sechs Monate als Entwickler im Core Team. Du baust Features, machst Reviews und lernst Codebasis, Fachlichkeit und Menschen von innen kennen. Danach übernimmst du die Führung des Teams. Wer ein Team führen will, das er nie von innen gesehen hat, führt es an dem vorbei, was zählt. 

Technisch: Python mit Django und Django Ninja im Backend, React mit TypeScript im Frontend, PostgreSQL mit TimescaleDB, deployt auf Kubernetes per GitOps mit ArgoCD. KI-Coding-Assistenten sind fester Teil des Workflows. In den ersten Monaten schreibst du diesen Code selbst. Danach musst du ihn weiter lesen können und verstehen, worüber dein Team diskutiert. 

In den ersten sechs Monaten 

- Du arbeitest als Entwickler im Core Team: Features end-to-end, Reviews, Deployments, Support-Fälle. Ohne Sonderrolle 

- Du lernst die Fachlichkeit von Messkonzept bis Abrechnung und die Geschichte der Codebasis, inklusive der Stellen, an denen sie weh tut 

- Du baust Vertrauen zu den Menschen im Team auf, weil du mit ihnen arbeitest und nicht über ihnen 

Danach 

- Du führst das Core Team: Einstellung, Onboarding, 1:1s, Entwicklung, Feedback. Die Menschen im Team sind deine erste Verantwortung 

- Du verantwortest die Lieferung: Zusammen mit Product priorisierst du nach wirtschaftlichem Wert und regulatorischem Druck, planst realistisch und sorgst dafür, dass Zugesagtes fertig wird 

- Du bringst Fachverständnis in die Produktentscheidungen ein: Du erkennst, wann eine Anforderung aus dem Markt kommt, wann aus einem einzelnen Kunden, und wann aus einem Missverständnis 

- Du hältst die technische Qualität hoch, ohne selbst der Flaschenhals zu sein: Du moderierst Architekturentscheidungen, forderst Tests und Reviews ein und schaffst Raum für Refactoring 

- Du bist die Schnittstelle zu Product, Support und den anderen Engineering-Teams, und du löst Konflikte, bevor sie im Sprint landen 

- Du machst Probleme sichtbar: Wenn etwas nicht klappt, sagst du es früh und mit Vorschlag statt spät und mit Ausrede 

- Du gestaltest Prozesse so, dass sie dem Team dienen, und schaffst die ab, die es nicht tun 

Dein Profil - Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung als Softwareentwickler mit Web-Anwendungen in Produktion. Du kannst in Django und React produktiv arbeiten oder dich in wenigen Wochen dort einfinden 

- Erfahrung in der Führung eines Entwicklungsteams, als Engineering Manager, Team Lead oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit Personalverantwortung 

- Du kannst ein Datenmodell beurteilen und eine Architekturdiskussion moderieren, ohne sie an dich zu reißen 

- Du willst wieder oder weiter Code schreiben, bevor du führst, und siehst das als Vorteil, nicht als Umweg 

- Erfahrung in der Energiewirtschaft, idealerweise in Messstellenbetrieb, Abrechnung, Marktkommunikation oder Mieterstrom. Du kennst Begriffe wie Messkonzept, MaLo oder OBIS nicht nur aus Wikipedia 

- Business-Verständnis: Du denkst vom Geschäftsmodell des Betreibers her, nicht vom Feature. Du kannst erklären, welche Anforderung Umsatz sichert, welche Risiko reduziert und welche nur schön ist 

- Du gibst direktes Feedback und hältst es aus, direktes Feedback zu bekommen 

- Du kannst Nein sagen, zu Stakeholdern und zum eigenen Team, und begründen, warum 

- Du fühlst dich in einem Startup wohl, in dem Strukturen noch entstehen und du sie mitgestaltest 

- Deutsch mindestens auf C1-Niveau, weil Fachlichkeit, Kunden und ein Großteil der Kommunikation deutsch sind 

Warum wir? - Eine Führungsrolle mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum in einer wachsenden Engineering-Organisation, mit einem Einstieg, der dich nicht ins kalte Wasser wirft 

- Direkter Draht zum CTO und Mitsprache bei der Teamstruktur, nicht nur bei der Umsetzung 

- Hybrid in Hamburg: 1-2 Tage im Office, der Rest remote 

- Ein Team ohne Hierarchieebenen. Wer eine bessere Idee hat, setzt sie um 

- Zuschuss zu Deutschlandticket, Bikeleasing, Urban Sports Club und betrieblicher Altersvorsorge 

- Ein Produkt, das die Energiewende konkret voranbringt, statt sie nur in die Präsentation zu schreiben

As our Senior Product Developer, you will bring technical depth to one of our most important categories and make sure every decision works in the real world: in the recipe, in the factory and in the customer’s hands.

- Strong knowledge of sugar reduction, sweetener systems, fibres and texture management.

description:

Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different:

Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here! 

At Malt we believe that Ambition is the Way, so all lists of missions and responsibilities are non-exhaustive. 

The Mission 🪐 

- The Situation: Malt is cementing its position as the undeniable leader in the European freelance economy. While our tech-powered platform connects over 1,000,000 top-tier freelancers with 100,000+ companies, the DACH Enterprise sector presents a massive, untapped frontier. This market is dominated by complex, multinational corporate structures with deeply entrenched procurement protocols that are ripe for disruption.

- The Task: We are not hiring you to manage an existing portfolio or farm warm leads. You are being brought in to architect and own the zero-to-one enterprise acquisition strategy for the DACH region. Operating as the "founder" of your territory, your mandate is to systematically penetrate massive global accounts, navigate labyrinthine procurement structures, and secure highly scalable, multi-country Master Service Agreements (MSAs) that will cement Malt's dominance in the German-speaking market and beyond.

Key Responsibilities ✨ 

Pillar 1: Strategic Territory Architecture & Hunting 

- Action: Map out complex, global enterprise accounts within the DACH region, aggressively designing and executing surgical prospecting strategies to breach heavily fortified multi-stakeholder environments (Procurement, HR, and independent Business Units).

- Output: A localized, highly qualified pipeline of net-new DACH Enterprise logos and concrete, multi-threaded stakeholder maps.

- Metrics of Performance: Enterprise GSV Pipeline Generated and CRM forecast integrity.

Pillar 2: Deal Orchestration & RFP Command 

- Action: Run rigorous, in-depth discovery utilizing the full MEDDIC framework to validate severe business pain, identify the true Economic Buyer, and aggressively lead end-to-end RFI/RFP processes alongside our Bid Management and technical teams.

- Output: Compelling, ROI-driven business proposals and precisely engineered enterprise pilot programs designed to prove undeniable platform value.

- Metrics of Performance: RFI/RFP Win Rate and Pilot-to-MSA Conversion Rate.

Pillar 3: Heavy-Weight Negotiation & Scalable Revenue Activation 

- Action: Command ruthless, complex negotiations for global Master Service Agreements involving tight friction with Legal, Finance, and Procurement across multiple countries. Upon signature, engineer the scalable handover strategy to the local Account Management teams.

- Output: Executed, multi-country MSAs and comprehensive post-signature deployment kickoff plans.

- Metrics of Performance: Total Contract Value (TCV) Signed and Deal Velocity (managing complex cycles efficiently without losing momentum).

Requirements & The Skills Matrix 🔍 
Proven Mastery (What you have already built): 

- A minimum of 8 years of quantifiable, proven track record hunting and closing complex, 7-figure B2B sales cycles within a SaaS/Tech environment.

- Deep familiarity with the staffing, "future of work" industry, MSPs, or Tier 1 recruitment groups.

- Demonstrated success navigating extremely long sales cycles and managing strategic concessions to close highly scalable deals.

- Native-level fluency in German and full professional fluency in English.

Skills You Will Deploy & Develop: 

- Advanced MEDDIC Mastery: You will deploy this framework with such rigor that you act as the internal benchmark and can actively coach others on its nuances.

- C-Suite ROI Narrative Construction: Mastering the art of delivering disruptive narratives that challenge legacy customer assumptions and shift C-level perspectives on the "Future of Work."

- Cross-Border Deal Structuring: Developing top-tier acumen in multi-country legal, financial, and compliance orchestration.

The Self-Selection Filter ❓ 

This role is perfect for you if: 

- You are an elite hunter who actively enjoys the strategic friction of a complex enterprise sales cycle and navigating massive corporate red tape.

- You operate with extreme ownership—you treat your pipeline like your own startup's P&L and do not wait for permission or inbound leads to execute.

- You naturally think in terms of "Economic Buyers," "Decision Criteria," and "Validation Events" rather than just "having good meetings."

This role is NOT for you if: 

- You rely heavily on inbound marketing or a pre-packaged SDR playbook to hit your pipeline numbers.

- You get easily intimidated by heavy-weight legal negotiations, aggressive procurement teams, or highly structured RFP processes.

- You prefer predictable, transactional account maintenance over the high-stakes thrill of net-new, multi-country enterprise acquisition.

30-60-90 Day Impact Plan 🏁 

- Day 30: Submerge into our marketplace mechanics, master the Malt value proposition, and map the top tier of DACH global enterprise accounts. Output: Delivery of your fully architected account penetration strategy.

- Day 60: Execute initial outreach, identify key Economic Buyers within target accounts, and begin orchestrating your first high-stakes pilot phases. Output: Establish a predictable, MEDDIC-qualified enterprise pipeline.

- Day 90: Take absolute control of your Metrics of Performance . Lead your first complex RFI/RFP processes or MSA negotiations end-to-end and initiate scalable handover plans. Output: Secure early enterprise traction that directly impacts the regional bottom line.

How to join the mission? 🚀 

- First Call (45m): High-level alignment with Niko (Talent Acquisition Lead) to audit your background and entrepreneurial drive.

- Strategic Deep Dive (60m): Interview with your future manager, Théo , to dissect your past enterprise deals and MEDDIC rigor.

- Business Case (60m): A live simulation to assess your technical account development, localized prospecting skills, and C-level narrative delivery.

- Final Vision Call (30m): Interview with our CRO to discuss Malt’s long-term scale and how your ambition aligns with our macro-economic growth.

Life on planet Malt is the perfect space to thrive personally and professionally 💫 

🤝 Onboarding: Before easing into your new role, you’ll spend your first week learning about our culture, products, and services with other onboardees at our office in Paris.

💻 Remote work: Hybrid remote policy - 3 days office / 2 days home-office.

🏖️ Annual leave: 30 days/year.

📆 Sabbatical: 1 month paid sabbatical once you've been with Malt for 3 years.

📈 Stock options: Every Malter is entitled to stock options. 

🍽️ Lunch vouchers: 6,50€ per day / 15 days a month.

🐶 Dog friendly office: In the heart of Munich/Berlin!

❓ Choose your Benefit: Transport reimbursement, Gym membership, Organic Food voucher or Rydes Mobility App.

📚 Free books: If you’re interested in learning more about any topic relevant to Malt’s business, just tell us the books you’d like to read, and we’ll order them for you—without any questions asked or approval processes to follow.

title: Senior Electronic Warfare Engineer
description:

By joining Hypersonica , you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. - 
Own the system architecture of Hypersonica's Electronic Warfare (EW) capability, ensuring electronic support (ES), electronic attack (EA), and electronic protection (EP) functions operate as a coherent and mission-effective system.

- 
Produce and maintain critical systems engineering artefacts including system specifications, interface control documents (ICDs), verification strategies, test plans, and design review materials. 

- 
Apply model-based systems engineering (MBSE) principles to ensure traceability between requirements, architectures, analyses, verification activities, and operational outcomes. 

- 
Identify and mitigate system-level risks, particularly around electromagnetic performance, interoperability, survivability, cybersecurity, verification, and platform integration. 

- 
Act as the technical authority for EW system engineering, working across RF, software, hardware, mission systems, cybersecurity, safety, and platform engineering disciplines to deliver robust operational capability. 

Who you are 

- 
An experienced Systems Engineer with 8+ years of experience delivering complex Electronic Warfare, RF, mission systems, avionics, aerospace, defence, or other mission-critical systems. 

- 
Strong background in systems architecture, requirements development, requirements decomposition, verification, and validation throughout the engineering lifecycle. 

- 
Deep understanding of Electronic Warfare concepts, including electronic support (ES), electronic attack (EA), electronic protection (EP), threat systems, and electromagnetic spectrum operations. 

- 
Experience integrating RF sensors, receivers, transmitters, antennas, signal processing systems, and mission computers into operational platforms. 

- 
Strong knowledge of electromagnetic environments, system performance analysis, modelling, simulation, and test methodologies. 

- 
Familiar with MBSE approaches and capable of applying systems engineering rigour to complex, multidisciplinary defence programmes. 

- 
Experienced supporting major design reviews, platform integration activities, flight trials, qualification programmes, and operational capability development. 

- 
Technically credible across multiple disciplines, capable of influencing decisions, challenging assumptions, and driving technical direction confidently. 

- 
Comfortable operating within fast-moving, high-accountability environments where ambiguity is high and execution speed matters. 

- 
Motivated by solving nationally significant defence challenges and building capabilities that directly contribute to European security and technological independence. 

Security and Eligibility Requirement 

Due to the nature of the work done at Hypersonica, applicants must be an EU/Nato/German citizen and be eligible for Security Clearance. 

What we offer 

- 
A mission-driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security. 

- 
Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow. 

- 
High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes. 

- 
A fast-paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from testing and operational activities drives real decisions. 

- 
A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly. 

- 
Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy. 

At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply.

Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential.

You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.

title: Senior Process Engieer
description:
ABOUT US tozero is Europe’s leading deep-tech startup specializing in the recycling of
lithium-ion batteries. Committed to accelerating decarbonization and transforming

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR We are looking for a Senior Process Engineer to take a leading technical role in the
design, scale-up, commissioning and ramp up of our battery recycling processes.
This role sits at the intersection of technology development, process engineering,
and industrial scale-up. You will translate experimental and operational data into
robust process designs, challenge engineering assumptions, and ensure that our
future plants are built on solid fundamentals.
Your focus will be on the processes that matter most to our technology — graphite
and lithium extraction. By working closely with R&D, Operations and external
engineering partners, you will actively lead and engage in activities associated with:
a) engineering design; b) commissioning and ramp up; c) process development.
We are looking for someone who is comfortable working in a production
environment, but who can also take a step back and understand what the data is
telling us, and engineer the process we need at different scales.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Must Have's: 
1. Future Plant Design & Scale-up
● Own key process design activities for our next-generation plants.
● Develop and review PFDs, P&IDs, mass and energy balances, process
descriptions and equipment specifications for future capacity expansions.

● Translate pilot and industrial operating data into reliable engineering design
criteria and scale-up assumptions.
● Perform process calculations and equipment sizing to ensure our future
plants are designed based on validated engineering data rather than
theoretical assumptions alone.
2. Targeted Process Expertise & Optimization
● Become a technical reference for some of our most critical process steps.
● Apply strong chemical engineering fundamentals to the optimization of
graphite and lithium extraction and post-processing.
● Identify the parameters controlling yield, purity and process stability and
translate these insights into concrete process improvements.
● Work closely with R&D and Operations while maintaining a strong focus on
process performance and technology development rather than daily
troubleshooting.
3. Data Analysis & Process Modeling
● Turn plant data into engineering decisions.
● Evaluate operational and experimental data, build and validate mass balances
and process models, and identify gaps between expected and actual process
performance.
● Define what data needs to be collected to support future scale-up decisions.
● Technically guide data analysts and other engineering functions to ensure
that models and analytics remain grounded in physical and chemical reality.
● Translate analysis into clear recommendations for process upgrades and
future plant designs.
4. Commissioning & Process Validation
● Make sure what we designed actually works.
● Participate in FATs/SATs, commissioning activities and process performance
validation for new equipment and plant expansions.
● Develop acceptance and process validation criteria based on the original
design intent.
● Evaluate commissioning and operational data to confirm that installed
systems achieve their calculated performance targets.
● Work closely with Operations during handover while ensuring clear ownership
transfers once the process meets its design criteria.
5. Operational Readiness, Process Safety & SOPs
● Design processes that can be operated safely and consistently.
● Translate process design and engineering intent into clear Standard Operating
Procedures (SOPs), operating envelopes and process documentation.
● Participate actively in HAZOPs, LOPAs, and other process safety reviews,
ensuring that process risks are identified and addressed during design rather
than after installation.
● Support Operations in understanding the design basis and critical process
parameters of newly commissioned systems.

Nice-to-have's: 
Vendor & EPC Coordination
● Represent tozero's process requirements with external engineering partners
and equipment suppliers.
● Prepare and review technical specifications, vendor proposals and engineering
documentation.
● Challenge unsupported assumptions, identify over-engineered solutions and
ensure equipment is correctly sized for our process.
● Support technical bid evaluations and equipment selection, balancing process
performance, CAPEX, operability and scalability.
● Act as a strong technical counterpart to EPCs, engineering contractors and
equipment vendors throughout project execution.

Your profile You have a strong chemical/process engineering foundation and enjoy solving
technically complex problems with a combination of first-principles engineering and
real plant data.
● Degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Metallurgical
Engineering or a related technical field.
● Ideally 5+ years of experience in process engineering within the chemical,
hydrometallurgy, battery, mining, minerals, recycling or related process
industries; specific expertise in graphite and lithium extraction and
post-processing is highly preferred.
● Strong experience with process design and scale-up, including PFDs, P&IDs,
mass/energy balances and equipment sizing.
● Comfortable working with industrial datasets and translating operational data
into engineering models and decisions.
● Experience with solid-liquid separation, precipitation, flotation,
hydrometallurgy or mineral processing is highly valuable.
● Able to critically review vendor proposals and confidently challenge technical
assumptions.
● Strong experience supporting commissioning and process validation of
industrial equipment or plants.
● Familiarity with process safety methodologies such as HAZOP and LOPA.
● Comfortable moving between detailed calculations, engineering
documentation and the actual plant.
● Strong communicator who can work effectively across R&D, Engineering,
Operations, suppliers and EPC partners.
● Fluent English; German is a plus.

Why us? Our technology is moving from first-of-a-kind industrial operations toward
increasingly larger and more standardized plants.
The Senior Process Engineer will help us make that transition successfully: turning
what we learn from today's plant into the engineering basis for tomorrow's plants
while supporting commissioning and ramping up efforts.
You will directly influence process performance, equipment selection, CAPEX and the
technical architecture of our future facilities — helping ensure that every new scale is
safer, simpler, more efficient and better engineered than the one before it.

What you can expect from us As part of our Sourcing & IT Advisory team, you will help clients shape and deliver complex business and IT transformations across industries.

Our tasks focus on complex transformation projects:
- Enterprise Architecture & Strategy: Define enterprise architecture strategies, governance models, target architectures, and roadmaps aligned with business objectives and value streams
- Business & Application Architecture: Design business capabilities, processes, application portfolios, and platform landscapes to enable scalable digital operating models
- Data & Integration Architecture: Develop modern information, data, API-first, integration, and event-driven architectures that ensure interoperability and business value
- Legacy Modernization & Technical Debt: Lead the transition from legacy and monolithic environments to cloud-native, modular, microservices-based architectures. Help clients to harmonize their diverse technology landscapes, work on their technical debt, and guide their IT migrations
- Technology Transformation: Design multi and hybrid cloud environments and new platforms reflecting requirements such as cloud migration and cloud exit options, business process resilience, open-source solutions, maintainability, and DevOps organizations and processes
- AI Architecture & Innovation: Drive AI readiness, define architectures for AI-enabled and agentic systems, and champion the effective use of AI tools to accelerate architecture, delivery, and decision-making
- Architecture Governance: Establish architecture principles, standards, processes, and decision frameworks to ensure sustainable enterprise-wide adoption
- Transformation Delivery: Advise business and IT stakeholders up to executive level, facilitate workshops, apply agile methodologies (e.g., SAFe), and ensure successful implementation of architectural change

Who you are - University degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field
- At least 4 years proven experience in Enterprise and IT Architecture, ideally across multiple industries
- Proficient in leveraging modern AI tools to improve architecture design, consulting, and delivery, with a mindset of continuously exploring and adopting emerging AI capabilities
- Excellent communication skills in English and German
- Willingness to travel as required for client engagements

Strong expertise in: 
- Enterprise Architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF), Architecture Governance, and Architecture Maturity Assessments
- Business Capability Management, Business-IT Alignment, IT Strategy, and IT Governance 
- Business, Application, Information, Data, Integration, Technology, and Security Architecture
- API-first, event-driven, service-oriented, cloud-native, and microservices architectures
- Data management concepts (e.g., master data management, data lakes, data mesh) 
- Enterprise platforms (e.g., SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow)
- Architecture modeling standards (e.g., ArchiMate)
- AI readiness, agentic AI architectures, and modern AI-enabled enterprise platforms 

Who we are We are a global digital transformation consulting firm with offices in Hamburg, Düsseldorf, Munich, Vienna, Atlanta, Singapore, and Shanghai. Since 2006, we have primarily advised DAX and Fortune Global 500 companies on digital transformation issues at the intersection of business and IT. Our strength lies in a comprehensive management-level consulting approach that ranges from IT strategy to the optimization and implementation of digitalization and transformation processes. For this, we have repeatedly been recognized by our clients and the business magazine BrandEins as “Best Consultants” and by Wirtschaftswoche as the winner of the “Best of Consulting” competition. A few of our great benefits: - A "Duz-Kultur", short communication channels, and many fantastic, experienced, and international colleagues
- International company events that are truly worthwhile — both professionally and personally
- Want a Deutschlandticket? We cover half the cost 
- Childcare subsidy — we pay half the daycare costs for your little ones 
- JobRad bike leasing and discounted gym membership (EGYM Wellpass) 
- Personalized professional development opportunities that help you grow both professionally and personally 
- Central location in downtown Hamburg and Munich with excellent bus and train connections — and hub locations in all major German cities 
- Fresh fruit, good coffee, snacks, soft drinks, and after-work beer—we’ve got it all 

Contact If you have any questions in advance, please contact Carolin Hilden at career.de . Our top priority is that you fit in with us and we with you, regardless of origin, nationality, sexual orientation, religion, gender identity, age, disability or other aspects of diversity. Please apply via our company portal with your CV and / or your updated Xing or Linked In profile. Are you interested in what our employees and other applicants say about us? title: Forward Deployed Engineer (all genders)
description:
What you can expect from us Eraneos supports AI initiatives from strategy all the way through to production. In most AI projects, there's a gap between the strategy and what actually ends up running in production and creating real value. That's exactly the gap we close. 

For us, the work doesn't stop at the concept stage, and it doesn't start only once the spec is finished: an initiative stays in one pair of hands from the first idea to the running system. We work in a results-driven way rather than following the classic consulting model. Our clients are primarily DAX and Fortune Global 500 companies. 

You help decide what gets built, not just how. We always work with the latest models and tools to succeed with the client. There's no prescribed stack — instead, we pick the right tool for each task. You design technical solutions from the first idea through to production deployment, working closely with decision-makers on both the client and management side. 

What to expect: 
- You own the architecture and technical implementation of the AI solution end to end — from strategy through to production 
- You build agentic systems, RAG pipelines, and LLM integrations in real enterprise environments 
- Agentic coding tools are your everyday toolkit: you use them to develop solutions, speed up reviews, and build deployment pipelines 
- You're involved from the very first idea, not just once the spec is finished — growing deeper into the strategic and business side along the way 
- You stay accountable until the end: you don't hand things off, you see the solution through until it's running and delivering impact 
- You represent your technical decisions directly at executive level and lead these conversations yourself, without going through an intermediary layer 

Who you are - You stand behind the whole outcome, not just one part of it. You stick with it until the solution is running in production and delivering impact, and you share in the responsibility for that — a founder and product mindset rather than simply executing tasks 
- You build hands-on, at the highest level — and you think beyond the code. From an engineering perspective, that means you've already taken LLM-based systems into production and understand the business rationale behind them, not just the architecture 
- You're convincing at executive level. You've already owned and defended technical decisions directly in front of top management. You bring this with you — we won't be developing you into it 
- Proven experience bringing LLM-based systems into production — ideally as a Forward-Deployed or Founding Engineer 
- Excellent, production-grade Python skills (e.g. FastAPI , containers, Git, CI/CD) and a deep understanding of agentic architectures, retrieval methods, and function calling 
- You use agentic coding tools as a core part of your toolkit, not as a gimmick — including building deployment pipelines 
- An appetite for picking up where classic engineering roles leave off, and for growing deeper into the strategic side 
- Ideally, experience in one of our core industries — Financial Services, Transportation & Logistics, Energy & Utilities, Life Sciences, Healthcare, Public Sector, Automotive, or Defence . More important than the specific industry is that you quickly get up to speed in a new, often regulated environment 
- German (at least C1) and business-fluent English 
- Willingness to work regularly on-site at client locations 
- A completed degree in computer science, mathematics, physics, data science, business informatics, or a comparable field ( Bachelor's or higher) 

Who we are - Shape the future with AI by working on diverse and impactful projects at the intersection of strategy, technology, and business.
- Work flexibly in a way that suits your life – with hybrid working models, flexible working hours, and the option to work from home.
- Enjoy an open, collaborative culture with flat hierarchies, an international team, and colleagues who are always willing to share their knowledge and support one another.
- A Great Place to Grow: Benefit from tailored learning opportunities, individualized career paths, and dedicated support for your professional and personal development.
- Be part of a strong international network of more than 1,300 colleagues and enjoy regular cross-office and international company events.
- Maintain a healthy work-life balance with flexible working models and, where appropriate, the opportunity to take a sabbatical.
- Take advantage of our Company Bike program and a subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership to support your health and wellbeing.
- Work from modern, centrally located offices in Hamburg, Munich, and Düsseldorf, as well as flexible hub locations across Germany's major cities.
- Enjoy complimentary drinks, fresh fruit, snacks, premium coffee – and, if you like, an after-work beer with your colleagues.
- Thrive in an environment built on trust, ownership, and continuous growth, where your ideas are valued regardless of your role or level of seniority

title: Senior Cloud Consultant - Data & AI Engineer (f/m/d, 4-Days-Week), German Speaking
description:
It’s time to change. We change! Über uns 
It’s time to change. We change! Willkommen bei Auvaria, wo Leidenschaft, Teamgeist und Verantwortung unsere Kultur prägen. Wir sind ein mehrfach ausgezeichneter AWS Consulting & Engineering Partner mit Büros in Wien, Hamburg und Belgrad und begleiten unsere Kunden als Trusted Advisor auf der gesamten Cloud Journey.

Über die Rolle 
Was auch immer unsere Kunden im Bereich Data & AI auf AWS vorhaben, wir entwerfen und entwickeln es gemeinsam vom ersten Architecture Workshop bis in Production mit ihnen. Dafür suchen wir dich: als Senior Solutions Architect für Data & AI verantwortest du End-to-End Projekte in deinem Bereich und gestaltest unsere wachsende Data & AI Business Unit aktiv mit.

Architektur & Delivery 
- Du führst die Entwicklung und Implementierung skalierbare AWS-Architekturen für Data Platforms und Gen AI- / Agentic AI-Lösungen
- Du sorgst für Security, Performance, Reliability und Kosteneffizienz bei unseren Kunden (AWS Well-Architected)
- Du triffst Architekturentscheidungen samt Trade-offs – und dokumentierst sie so, dass Teams darauf aufbauen können
- Du übersetzt vage Business-Pain-Points in messbare technische Anforderungen und klare Ziele
- Du bringst Außenperspektive ein und hebst unsere bestehenden Standards auf das nächste Level.
- Du beteiligst dich bei technical Pre-Sales, Scoping von Projekten und arbeitest an der Erstellung der Statements of Work
Data & AI 
- Du entwickelst Generative AI und Agentic AI Solutions auf AWS Bedrock, mit Frameworks wie Strands Agents und Runtime- / Governance-Bausteinen wie Bedrock AgentCore
- Du entwickelst Agenten-Architekturen mit Tool Use und MCP-basierten Integrationen, Multi-Step-Orchestrierung und klar definierten Grenzen des Agent-Scopes
- Du baust Human-in-the-Loop-Patterns ein, von Approval-Steps und Eskalationslogik bis zu (teil-)automatisierten Review-Schleifen
- Du etablierst Evaluation und Qualitätssicherung für LLM- und Agent-Systeme
- Du zeigst Kunden, wie sie GenAI und Agentic AI pragmatisch und verantwortungsvoll einsetzen
Consulting & Pre-Sales 
- Du bist Trusted Technical Advisor für unsere Kunden
- Du unterstützt Pre-Sales und technische Workshops
- Du übersetzt komplexe Technik in klaren Business Value
- Knowledge Sharing
- Du bist Mentor:in für unsere Junior-Kolleg:innen
- Du bringst dich in interne Standards, Best Practices und Trainings ein und entwickelst diese mit uns weiter

Dein Profil: Must-haves 
- 5+ Jahre in Cloud, Data, Software oder ML Engineering – davon 2+ Jahre mit Ownership für End-to-End-Architekturen
- Starke Hands-on-Expertise mit AWS
- Fundierte Erfahrung in Data Engineering und ETL-Architekturen
- Erfahrung mit Generative / Agentic AI Projekten
- Sehr gute Python-Skills
- Verhandlungssicheres Englisch; Deutsch auf professionellem Niveau

Nice-to-haves 
- AWS-Zertifizierungen
- Erfahrung in Pre-Sales oder technischer Führung
- Erfahrung im Consulting oder in kundennahen Projekten
- Erfahrung mit AWS Connect
- Solide Erfahrung mit IaC (Terraform oder vergleichbar)
- Erfahrung mit LLM Customization / Fine-Tuning und Distillation
- Praktische MLOps-Erfahrung (Model Deployment, Monitoring, Lifecycle)
- Erfahrung mit Kafka/Streaming

Erstklassige Benefits für deine Karriere! Vergütung und Vergütungspaket 
Bei Auvaria bekommst du mehr als nur einen Job, weil wir davon überzeugt sind, dass Performance nur unter den richtigen Bedingungen gelingen kann:
- 4-Tage-Woche (bei 36h reduzierter Wochenarbeitszeit) mit vollem Fokus auf Impact.
- Attraktives Package mit teilweise variablem Gehaltsbestandteil, abhängig von deiner Erfahrung.
- Schneller, transparenter Hiring-Prozess (in der Regel max. 3 Gespräche, Angebot typischerweise innerhalb von 4 Wochen).
- Persönliches Mentoring und strukturiertes Onboarding ab Tag 1. AWS-Zertifizierungen komplett von uns bezahlt.
- Remote-freundliches Setup mit wenig Reisetätigkeit (max. 20 % im Jahresschnitt). Regelmäßige Team- und Afterwork-Events an unseren Standorten plus gemeinsame Offsites.
Wenn das nach dir klingt, dann bewirb dich! Wir freuen uns, dich kennenzulernen!

title: Account Executive – Full-Cycle, New Business (m/f/d)
description:
THE JOB Reading this to the end is worth it. 

The Company: Why mute-labs? 

mute-labs is the EU market leader in acoustic phone booths, with more than 20,000 cabins sold and counting. We are self-funded, profitable since day one, and have no investors to answer to and no exit to chase. What we do have is a steep growth curve in revenue, a product made in Germany, and a genuine mission: giving the modern office some quiet back. 

We have built a strong direct and dealer business on the back of inbound demand and word of mouth. What we have not built yet is a real outbound engine for winning bigger accounts on purpose, from ambitious growth companies to household names like Volkswagen, adidas, IKEA, Red Bull, or Axel Springer, who already trust us today. That gap is this role, and how far into that world you grow is largely up to you. 

Outbound is not a new idea for us. We have piloted it in smaller pockets already, testing signal-based outreach and structured sequences with real results. What has been missing is someone to own this as a dedicated motion for bigger accounts rather than a side project squeezed in between other things. That is why we are building this out as a new department and you’d be joining a small, yet focussed team as one of the first hires. 

The Role: Build the Pipeline AND the Channel 

This is a founding position. You are not stepping into an existing sales org with a quota handed down from three reps before you. You are the first one in the building. What you build, and how you build it, is largely up to you and your team, and you can grow the size and ambition of your target accounts as you find your footing. 

- Green Field, Full Ownership: Build your own pipeline from scratch. There is no inherited book of business and no recycled leads. The customer base you build is yours, and so is the revenue you generate from it. 

- Your Stack, Your Sequences: Clay, Reply.io, LinkedIn Premium, and Aircall are all at your disposal. You design your own outreach sequences, run your own cold calling campaigns, and decide how the machine works. Nobody hands you a script. 

- Segment Strategy, Together: You understand the market as well as anyone. Rather than being handed a target list from above, you and your manager will decide together which segments and account types are worth focusing on. 

- Comp That Rewards More Than the First Deal: An uncapped bonus with a kicker for overperformance. Returning customers you bring in keep feeding your comp over time, not just the initial close. Landing an account well is worth more than landing it once. 

- A Brand That Opens Doors: You are not cold-calling on behalf of an unknown startup. mute-labs is an established, well-regarded market leader with a reference list that already includes some of the biggest names in German and European business. That credibility is yours to use from day one. 

- A seasoned team to back you up: Your manager has built and run outbound and enterprise sales hands-on, from cold pipeline to six-figure closes, and will work closely with you from day one, coaching, supporting, and training wherever it's actually needed rather than just checking in on numbers. 

Is This You? 

- The Go-Getter: You do not wait to be told what to do next. You get on your feet quickly, figure out the shape of the problem, and start moving before anyone has to push you. 

- Sales Experience: You have carried a full sales cycle before, from first contact to signed contract, and know how to keep a deal moving without needing someone else to close it for you. You do not need to have sold into large enterprises already, that is something you will grow into here. 

- Stakeholder Management: You know how to work a deal with more than one person in the room, decision-makers, influencers, and budget holders, and you can keep several of those relationships moving in parallel without losing the thread. 

- Comfortable with Ambiguity: There is no existing playbook to inherit here. You will help write it. If you need every process defined for you before you can start, this is not the role. 

- Fluent in German and English: Most of your target accounts are DACH-based, though the reference list extends across the EU. Strong German is expected; English is the internal working language. 

Our Hiring Process 

We keep this fast and honest, on both sides. 

- The Spark: A short intro call with our People team to check for basic fit. 

- The deepdive: A conversation with your future manager Patrick about your experience, how you build your pipeline and how you close. Here you’ll also meet the rest of the team. 

- The Live Action: A live discovery or negotiation role-play based on a realistic enterprise scenario. No prep deck, just show us how you actually work a deal. 

- The Vision: A final conversation with Leah, Head of Sales as well as Franziskus, Managing Director, on the strategic mandate behind this role and where it can go from here. 

ABOUT US mute-labs exists to make quiet a normal part of the modern workplace. A few things that set us apart: 

- We are "no tech" : we build and sell real hardware, sound-insulated phone and meeting booths that companies actually need. 

- We have no investors , and we are not looking for any. We have been profitable since day one. 

- We are on a steep growth curve , measured in revenue and profit, not headcount for its own sake. 

- We are not building toward an exit . We are building a company meant to last for generations. 

Skip the Queue Told you it was worth reading to the end. 

We are looking for someone with a go-getter attitude who does not wait around for permission. So here is your first test: don't apply through the form. Cold call your future manager, Patrick, directly. 

+49 15888 279908 

If you get through and make your case, you've already shown us more than any CV could.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will play a pivotal role in the successful development, integration and deployment of Auterion-powered drone systems. 

In this role, you will collaborate closely with the production, hardware engineering, and firmware/software teams, as well as operations, ensuring that every platform transitions smoothly from an airframe concept into a fully validated flying robot ready for deployment. You will serve as the primary technical interface for partners, work closely with them to understand their technical requirements, configure and adapt existing solutions, contribute to core software development, and ensure successful implementation. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with customer collaboration and system-level problem solving, bridging the gap between hardware, firmware, and real-world flight performance. 

Responsibilities and Duties 

- Operate in a highly hands-on environment with evolving system requirements, rapidly iterating across hardware and software integration challenges.

- Manage software releases and perform firmware flashing and configuration using PX4 or adjacent autopilot ecosystems, including sensor calibration, ESC tuning, and system bring-up.

- Provide deep avionics and airframe expertise, including autopilot tuning, sensor and payload integration, power systems and airworthiness considerations.

- Work independently to troubleshoot integration and flight-readiness issues while collaborating cross-functionally with hardware engineering, firmware/software teams, operations, and QC engineering to escalate complex challenges when required.

- Act as the primary technical authority in customer engagements, translating mission requirements into concrete system architectures and demonstrable solutions built on AuterionOS and Skynode.

- Participate in flight testing activities to validate platform stability, safety, and mission performance, resolving technical issues often directly in the field during customer trials and demonstrations.

- Contribute to technical documentation and continuous improvement of engineering processes.

- Feed customer and market requirements back into product and engineering teams to influence the roadmap of the Auterion stack.

Qualifications and Skills 

- Degree in Software, Aviation, Robotics, Electrical, Mechanical Engineering, or related field (M.Sc. optional).

- Experience working with autopilots (ideally based on PX4), mission planning and navigation software, for example performing firmware flashing, vehicle configuration, and flight validation.

- Familiarity with UAV flight testing, system validation, and troubleshooting in real-world operational environments is a plus.

- Understanding of control theory, flight control, plus manufacturing and QC best practices.

- Basic mechanical system and design experience as well as an understanding of fundamental electronics principles including wiring diagrams.

- Solid understanding of embedded communication protocols (CAN, I2C, SPI, etc.) and computer networking principles, firmware debugging, and hardware-software integration.

- Proficiency in C/C++ development and working knowledge of datalink protocols, experience with MAVLink and Python is a plus.

- Familiarity with Linux-based development and debugging environments, including Docker.

- Strong collaboration and communication skills when working with cross-functional engineering and operations teams.

- Proven ability to operate as a technical lead in front of customers, including live demonstrations and field troubleshooting.

- Ability to work independently in fast-paced environments with evolving technical challenges, showing strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

- Passion for drone technology and a hands-on engineering mindset focused on building reliable flying systems.

- Willingness to travel for on-site integration, testing, and deployment activities.

- EU citizenship required.

Benefits

- Stock Options

- Generous holiday allowance

- Pension plan 

- Extended social security package 

- Enhanced maternity & paternity leave

- Wellpass membership
