Senior Platform Product Manager (Contract Position)
description:
Headquarters: Ukraine - Remote

Who We Are 

Pindrop is the Real Human + Right Human® Identity Trust Platform for the AI era. As AI-driven fraud and deepfakes erode trust in digital communication, Pindrop delivers continuous identity verification and deepfake detection across voice, video, and digital interactions in real time.

Enterprises rely on Pindrop to secure billions of high-risk customer interactions each year, including top U.S. banks, as well as leading insurers and healthcare providers. Powered by models trained on more than 1.5 billion real-world interactions annually and protected by 300+ patents, Pindrop restores trust while reducing fraud, lowering operational costs, and improving customer experience.

Recognized by TIME as one of 2025’s Best Inventions and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG.

What you’ll do 

Pindrop is looking for a high-performing Senior Platform Product Manager to drive strategy and development for the Pindrop Platform — the shared foundation that powers our products (Protect, Passport, and Pulse) and a set of platform capabilities exposed directly to customers, such as Pindrop Intelligence. You’ll ensure that our platform is scalable, reliable, easy to build on, and delivers differentiated value both to internal product teams and to customers consuming platform features directly.

Market analysis & customer insight 

- Stay ahead of competitive and industry trends in platforms, data products, and developer ecosystems.Partner with Product and GTM teams to understand how Protect, Passport, Pulse and other product lines depend on the Pindrop Platform today and what they will need next.

- Regularly engage with customers and partners who consume platform capabilities (e.g., Pindrop Intelligence APIs, data services) to understand use cases, workflows, and unmet needs.

- Manage organization goals, business metrics, and KPIs for the platform, including adoption, reliability, performance, and developer experience.

- Operate internal and external steering forums to align stakeholders on priorities and investments for the platform.

Vision & roadmap for the Pindrop Platform 

- Set the overall vision, strategy, and success measures for the Pindrop Platform as a product in its own right.

- Define how shared platform capabilities (data, AI/ML services, APIs, integrations, observability, security, entitlements, and configuration) evolve to support Protect, Passport, Pulse and future products.

- Own and maintain prioritized platform roadmaps, balancing foundational investments (scalability, reliability, security, cost efficiency) with new capabilities and externalized features like Pindrop Intelligence.

- Write clear user and system narratives that describe how internal product teams, external developers, and end customers will interact with Pindrop Platform capabilities.

- Define, document, and communicate objectives, requirements, and constraints for platform initiatives and releases.

- Engage with executive and cross-functional stakeholders to obtain buy-in, make tradeoffs, and raise escalations when needed.

Execution & delivery 

- Drive end-to-end execution for platform initiatives, from discovery and design through delivery and launch.

- Work with engineering and engineering leadership to design and deliver high-quality, continuous releases of platform services, APIs, and data products.

- Manage platform capabilities across their lifecycle, from initial MVPs to scaled, hardened services adopted across multiple products.

- Integrate new technology from research and product teams into the platform in a way that is reusable, well-abstracted, and easy to adopt.

- Collaborate with go-to-market partners to position platform capabilities (such as Pindrop Intelligence) and accelerate customer adoption and time to value.

- Partner with marketing to set positioning and develop market-facing materials, demos, and content for platform features where they are directly consumed by customers.

- Grow platform adoption and influence by assisting Sales, Customer Success, and Solutions Engineering with identifying key customer segments, building pipeline, and closing opportunities where platform capabilities are a differentiator.

Who you are 

- You are passionate about platforms , APIs , and developer experiences , and you understand how strong platform strategy accelerates product teams and unlocks new customer value.

- You care deeply about security, reliability, and performance, and you are comfortable working in a space that spans voice, identity, fraud, and AI/ML-powered intelligence.

- You have a high degree of integrity and trustworthiness.

- You have a strong sense of personal ownership and responsibility in accomplishing the organization’s goals.

- You are entrepreneurial with a high level of energy, dedication, and an unrelenting drive to succeed and win.

- You are resilient in the face of challenges, change, and ambiguity.

- You are optimistic and believe that you can make a problem into a solution.

- You are resourceful, excited to uncover innovative solutions and teach yourself something new when needed.

- You take accountability, do the things you say you’ll do, under-promise and over-deliver.

- You are nimble and adaptable when priorities change and continue to see the “forest through the trees”.

Your skill-set 

- 5–7 years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, with significant time spent on platform, infrastructure, or shared services (e.g., data platforms, API platforms, developer platforms, or similar).

- Experience working with cloud-native architectures and highly distributed systems; familiarity with how platform decisions impact reliability, performance, cost, and security.

- Proven experience defining and executing go-to-market strategy for platform or API / data products, including positioning, packaging, pricing, and launch planning.

- Demonstrated ability to partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Solutions Engineering to translate platform capabilities into clear value propositions, customer narratives, and enablement.

- Experience creating and scaling internal platforms that serve multiple product teams or business units, OR externalized platforms / APIs used directly by customers and partners.

- Technical background or strong technical fluency; you can work closely with engineering on APIs, data models, integration patterns, and system tradeoffs.

- Experience within a SaaS company required; experience in security, identity, fraud, or risk is a plus but not required.

- Proven track record of successful product or platform launches and meaningful impact on adoption, usage, or business outcomes.

- Comfortable rolling up your sleeves to dig into details, understand edge cases, or help unblock teams.

- Strong leadership and communication skills — you can bring clarity to complex technical topics and drive alignment across engineering, product, GTM, and executive stakeholders.

- Transparent and open about what works and what doesn’t; you use data and feedback to iterate quickly.

Within 30 days, you’ll 

- Complete onboarding and understand Pindrop as a product portfolio and the voice security space.

- Learn the core capabilities of the Pindrop Platform and how Protect, Passport, and Pulse are built on top of it.

- Meet your key partners across Product, Platform Engineering, Protect/Passport/Pulse teams, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Solutions Engineering.

- Review existing platform roadmaps, customer feedback, and GTM materials for platform features (including Pindrop Intelligence).

Within 60 days, you’ll 

- Refine and socialize a clear problem/opportunity framing for your initial focus areas on the Pindrop Platform.

- Own and update a portion of the platform roadmap, aligning it with product needs and GTM priorities.

- Lead discovery with internal product teams and select customers/partners to validate requirements for upcoming platform initiatives.

- Collaborate with GTM partners to shape positioning, messaging, and launch plans for at least one upcoming platform or Pindrop Intelligence enhancement.

Within 90 days, you’ll 

- Fully own a meaningful slice of the Pindrop Platform roadmap and associated KPIs.

- Drive at least one platform initiative from definition through execution, partnering closely with engineering and GTM teams.

- Establish lightweight rituals (reviews, steering, reporting) that bring clarity to platform priorities, tradeoffs, and status.

- Identify and propose medium-term platform and GTM bets that can unlock new value for products and customers.

What’s in it for you 

As a Pindropper, you join a rapidly growing company making technology more human with the power of voice. You will work alongside some of the best and brightest. We’re a passionate group committed to excellence - but that doesn’t stop us from enjoying the journey as a team with chess and poker tournaments, catered lunches and happy hours, wellness programming, and more. Because we take our jobs seriously, we add in time for rest with Unlimited PTO, Focus Thursday, and Company-wide Rest Days. 

What we offer 

As part of Pindrop, you’ll directly influence our products and contribute to shaping the future of voice security. We invest in great people and support them with great benefits:

- Competitive compensation, including equity for all employees

- Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)

- Remote-first culture

This position is contracted through Alcor BPO. 

Not sure if this is you? 

We want a diverse, global team, with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you’re not sure if you qualify, apply anyway! We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.

AI - A Transformative Force 

At Pindrop, we view artificial intelligence as a transformative force that, when harnessed responsibly, can unlock unprecedented value for our customers, partners and society and enable and empower us to continue to deliver cutting-edge technology to combat fraud and unblur the lines between what it means to be human versus machine.

Pindrop may use AI tools to help prioritize job applications for human review. The AI tool may analyze your work experience and skills to assess fit for the role, but does not consider your name or contact details. Applications with the strongest match to job requirements are prioritized for human review; not all applications may be individually reviewed.

Pindrop is an Equal Opportunity Employer 

Here at Pindrop, it is our mission to create and maintain a diverse and inclusive work environment. As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, disability, marital and/or veteran status.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/pindrop-senior-platform-product-manager-contract-position

title: Staff Product Manager
description:
Headquarters: United States

Our Mission and Opportunity 

Early education is one of the most important determinants of childhood outcomes, a critical support for working families, and a $175B market that remains underserved by modern technology. Brightwheel is the largest, fastest growing, and most loved platform in early ed, trusted by millions of educators and families every day. We are a three-time Cloud 100 company , backed by top investors including Addition, Bessemer, Emerson Collective, Lowercase Capital, Notable Capital, and Mark Cuban. 

Our Team 

Our team is passionate, talented, and customer-focused. We embody our Leadership Principles in our work and culture. We are a distributed team with remote employees across every US time zone, as well as select offices in the US and internationally. 

Who You Are 

You’re an AI-native, experienced product manager who thrives in high-ownership environments and knows what it means to truly own a core product area. You’re energized by the full spectrum of the job — from iterating on live features to investing in greenfield 0→1 bets — and you have the judgment to know when to pursue each. You’re comfortable in ambiguity, decisive under pressure, and relentless about customer impact.

You are:

- A product owner who has driven a core product area end-to-end — setting strategy and goals, building the roadmap, and delivering measurable outcomes

- Sharp on prioritization — you can look at a universe of possible bets and quickly identify what’s worth pursuing, what to cut, and why

- Skilled at right-sizing — you set appetite and scope work accordingly, balancing incremental improvements with bigger swings

- Impact and customer-obsessed — you keep the customer and business at the forefront, and know how to cut through the noise to focus on what truly matters to drive value

- AI-native in how you work — you use AI tools daily to move faster, think more clearly, and raise your own ceiling as a PM

- A strong cross-functional partner — you build trust with engineering, design, and partners, and know how to move a team forward with clarity and momentum

- A boundaryless builder — you prototype, automate, and ship using AI as your co-builder

What You’ll Do 

This is an individual contributor role with significant scope and exposure. You will own a core product area and partner directly with our CEO and CTO to deliver product experiences that matter to the business and to our customers. You’ll:

- Own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for a portion of our core SaaS product — from iterating on existing features to defining and launching new ones

- Balance 0→1 product bets with high-leverage incremental improvements, knowing when to invest big and when to right-size

- Set appetite, scope accordingly, and hold your pod to a high bar on speed, quality, and customer impact

- Drive AI into the product in ways that genuinely improve outcomes for providers and families — not as a checkbox

- Define success metrics, track performance, and communicate progress and tradeoffs clearly to leadership

- Partner tightly with engineering and design to ship with urgency, unblock the team, and keep the pod focused on what matters

- Contribute to brightwheel’s product culture — raise the bar for product quality, velocity, and customer impact

What You Bring 

We are open to a variety of backgrounds, but strong candidates usually bring:

- 5+ years of product management experience with meaningful ownership of a core product area

- Proven ownership of complex, cross-functional product initiatives with measurable outcomes

- Strong product judgment and prioritization — you know what to work on, what to cut, and can drive alignment while balancing speed, quality, and learning

- Deep comfort with product metrics, experimentation, and funnel analysis (SQL a plus)

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including with executive audiences

- A strong sense of ownership and bias toward action — you define the problem, you don't wait for it to be handed to you

- AI fluency in your daily workflow — you use AI tools to move faster, go deeper, and operate more like a full-stack product owner across discovery, design, and execution

- Experience building and shipping AI-powered product features (bonus)

- B2B SaaS background, especially in products with complex operational workflows (bonus)

Brightwheel is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment and is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. 

Protecting Our Applicants: Please be aware of recruiting scams impersonating Brightwheel. All legitimate communications come from @ mybrightwheel.com addresses, and we never ask for payment or sensitive personal data as part of our hiring process. If you suspect fraudulent contact, reach out to security@mybrightwheel.com . Thank you for helping us keep our applicant community safe. 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/brightwheel-staff-product-manager

title: Senior Technical Product Manager
description:
Headquarters: United Kingdom

About Us 

Simprints is a nonprofit tech company with a mission to radically increase transparency and effectiveness in global development. We build ethical, inclusive digital ID powered by biometrics to verify that health, aid, and services truly reach people. Simprints partners with organizations like Gavi to boost immunisation rates in developing countries, Ministries of Health like Ghana on pandemic response , and NGOs like BRAC to deliver maternal healthcare . Studies have shown Simprints increases impact through real-time, precision data, for example increasing maternal health visits by 38% in Bangladesh or accurate HIV tracing by 62% in Malawi. Today we’ve worked in over 17 countries helping deliver health, aid, and finance to >4M people. Our goal is to transform the way the world fights poverty, ensuring that every vaccine, every dollar, and every public good reaches the people who need them most.

About the Role 

We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to be the champion of our customers, diving deep into their experiences, pain points, and aspirations to ensure that our products not only meet but exceed their expectations. This role is critical in our journey towards achieving and maintaining product-market fit. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background, exceptional communication skills, and a passion for customer-centric product development. If building technology for global health sounds exciting, we want to meet you! 

Job Details 

- Job Title: Senior Technical Product Maanger
- Reporting To: Chief Product Officer 
- Grade: UK Grade IC6 - £60,000 - £70,000
- Location: Remote

Department Overview 

Primary Function: The Product and Engineering department at Simprints is focused on developing innovative biometric solutions to help solve the problems of our users. We take a product-centric approach, ensuring our technology drives social impact through close collaboration and user-focused design.

Key Goals:

- Enhance Biometric Solutions: Continuously improve our biometric products to ensure they are adaptable, reliable, and meet the diverse needs of our users.
- Drive Cross-Company Product Development: Promote collaboration across the entire company to accelerate the delivery of impactful, user-focused features.
- Ensure User Success: Go above and beyond to ensure our users benefit from our technology by providing ongoing support, troubleshooting, and guidance, while actively participating in decision-making and project implementation.
Role Responsibilities 

- Working within the department to own problems all the way to the delivery of solutions
- Coordinate dependencies between Mobile and Cloud engineering teams to ensure seamless solution delivery.
- Gathering and synthesising customer insights from internal teams (e.g., Partnerships, Operational Delivery) and external sources (field visits, user interviews, market research) to inform product development.
- Support prioritising high-level problems to solve in the product backlog.
- Reviewing our projects to determine how well our product is performing
- Work with Engineering Managers who run the development teams, ensuring they are involved and informed. Facilitating their participation in stakeholder calls and field visits to grow their autonomy in their respective teams.
- Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technology and best practices in our sector. 
- Grow our customer obsession in everything we do through education, processes, and tools.
- 5+ years of experience as a product manager in an agile environment, working on mobile or cloud-based products
- Strong technical background with the ability to understand and discuss technical concepts with a variety of different audiences. 
- Experience managing technical products and roadmaps
- Proficiency with an issue-tracking tool (e.g. JIRA, YouTrack) 
- Ability to communicate effectively across many levels, building strong interpersonal relationships with engineers, designers, operational managers, and external stakeholders
5 Reasons to Join Simprints

Life is short. We believe work should be inspirational, meaningful and fun. At Simprints, we’re taking on global development’s biggest challenges, powered by an amazing culture and incredible people. Work with us, and you will grow faster, learn more, and take on great responsibilities with the potential to make lasting change.

1. Genuine Impact. Work directly with our partners and users to deliver technology that has the potential to impact millions of lives across the globe. At Simprints, you’ll be part of a team that is passionate about driving real change.

2. An incredible, diverse team. Our work is at the intersection of technology and global development, and we’ve managed to build an amazing team drawn from all over the world. But don’t take our word for it—we’re an externally recognised as a Great Place to Work , and a 2025 Best Workplace for Women amonst many other accolades. 

3. Mutual Flex. We champion a work culture where autonomy and trust are paramount, steering clear of mere face-time metrics. Whether it's managing life's essentials like healthcare appointments or adapting work hours to match your peak productivity times, we've got you covered. In return, we count on your reciprocal flexibility when mission-critical moments arise, like stepping up for a crucial client discussion on a Friday or tackling unexpected technical glitches beyond regular hours. 

4. Ultimate work-life balance. 

- We offer a 4-day workweek, meaning everybody has the option to have Fridays off.
- We also offer unlimited annual leave, which allows you to prioritise your well-being
As long as you're driving results and fostering teamwork, we encourage you to strike that perfect balance between your professional and personal life. Our commitment to this model's success is solidified through semi-annual productivity assessments with our board, ensuring that our high standards of performance are consistently met.

5. Professional development. We promote continual learning and put our money where our mouth is with development plans and access to global experts through the GLG network 

We also have a generous professional development budget for each colleague – “Eduprints”. Is there some training you’d like, or maybe you could benefit from professional coaching? Simply provide a business case that shares your aspirations and the resources you need, and we'll do our best to support you. 

We care about both your development in Simprints and your holistic long-term career goals. Simprints Alumni have gone on to work for Google, USAID, Gavi the vaccine alliance, Save the Children, and other top players.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/simprints-senior-technical-product-manager

title: Technical Product Marketer - K0rdent AI
description:
Headquarters: Austin, TX, USA

Company Description

Mirantis is the Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production-ready developer platforms across any environment—on-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy.

https://www.mirantis.com/ 

Job Description

- Develop and maintain core positioning, messaging frameworks, and value propositions for Mirantis’ AI infrastructure and cloud-native platform portfolio.

- Translate highly technical product capabilities — GPU cluster orchestration, multi-cluster Kubernetes management, MLOps pipelines — into audience-specific narratives for practitioners, platform engineers, and C-suite buyers.

- Own the competitive intelligence function: track competitors including Red Hat OpenShift AI, NVIDIA Base Command, Rancher/SUSE, VMware Tanzu, and emerging AI cloud providers; produce battlecards, comparisons, and win/loss analysis.

- Produce a steady cadence of high-quality technical content: solution briefs, white papers, blog posts, use case studies, reference architectures, and demo scripts.

- Partner with solution architects and product managers to develop technical content that educates buyers on AI infrastructure patterns, including LLM inference at scale, GPU scheduling, and developer platform self-service.

- Support demand generation campaigns with compelling assets aligned to key personas: AI/ML engineers, platform ops teams, and infrastructure decision-makers.

- Build and maintain sales enablement materials, including pitch decks, battlecards, objection-handling guides, and ROI frameworks.

- Partner with solution architects and sales teams to distill field learnings into sharper messaging and better-targeted content.

- Support product launches with go-to-market plans, launch kits, and internal training materials.

- Monitor trends across the AI infrastructure, cloud-native, and open-source ecosystems to surface market insights that inform GTM strategy.

- Support analyst and media briefings; contribute to Mirantis’ positioning in key industry conversations and reports.

- Represent Mirantis’ platform perspective at industry events, webinars, and community forums as a subject matter resource.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications 

- 4–7 years of experience in product marketing, technical marketing, or a closely adjacent role (solutions marketing, developer marketing, content strategy) within the cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or enterprise software space.

- Demonstrated ability to understand and credibly communicate complex technical concepts related to:

- Kubernetes, container orchestration, and cloud-native platforms

- AI/ML infrastructure, including model serving, inference, GPU resource management, and MLOps tooling

- Hybrid and multi-cloud deployment patterns across AWS, GCP, and Azure

- Strong writing and storytelling skills — able to produce clear, engaging content for both technical and business audiences without heavy editing.

- Experience developing sales enablement materials and working directly with sales and pre-sales teams.

- Familiarity with the competitive landscape across cloud infrastructure, AI platforms, and open-source ecosystems (e.g., Red Hat, NVIDIA, Canonical, Rancher/SUSE, HashiCorp).

- Comfort working in a fast-paced, distributed environment with a high degree of autonomy. 

Soft Skills and Team Fit 

- Intellectually curious with a genuine interest in how AI infrastructure works under the hood.

- Strong cross-functional collaborator — comfortable engaging with engineers, product managers, and executives alike.

- Structured thinker who can manage multiple projects and deadlines without losing narrative coherence.

- Passion for open source, developer communities, and the cloud-native ecosystem.

- Entrepreneurial mindset with a bias toward shipping content and iterating quickly.

Nice to Have 

- Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, MLflow, Kubeflow, Ray, or similar infrastructure tooling.

- Background in or exposure to AI/ML engineering, DevOps, or platform engineering.

- Prior experience in or familiarity with companies like RunPod, SpectroCloud, Rafay, Anyscale, Hugging Face, Together AI, or Modal.

- Experience supporting analyst relations or contributing to industry research and reports.

- CNCF ecosystem knowledge or cloud/Kubernetes certifications a plus.

Additional Information

What does Mirantis offer you? 

- Work with an established Silicon Valley leader in the cloud infrastructure industry.

- Work with exceptionally passionate, talented and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers implement next-generation cloud technologies.

- Be a part of cutting-edge, open-source innovation.

- Thrive in the high-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth are valued.

- Receive a competitive compensation package with strong benefits plan

We are a Leader for Container Management in G2 (#2 after AWS)!

title: Data Analyst (Wellbeing product)
description:
Headquarters: Ukraine

Kiss My Apps — компанія-платформа, що об’єднує 7 продуктових вертикалей та 30+ AI-first продуктів, 100+ мільйонів користувачів, власну екосистему аналітичних, пеймент та маркетингових розробок.

Продукти KMA це світові лідери в нішах utilities, lifestyle, health&fitness — AI Remodel, Printer, Botan, Calorie Counter і не тільки. Це продукти, що займають топ-1 місця App Store й вирішують потреби комʼюніті з сотень мільйонів людей.

Наш темп — це наш competitive advantage. KMA зростає мінімум х3 рік до року — і ми шукаємо Data Analyst , того/ту, хто допоможе масштабуватись ще швидше.

Коротко про роль: 
Команда Chillio шукає Data Analyst, який(а) візьме на себе ownership над розвитком і масштабуванням аналітики та в майбутньому стане Лідом напрямку. 

У цій ролі ви будуватимете нашу data-основу з нуля, створюватимете потужні аналітичні пайплайни та перетворюватимете дані на чіткі, практичні інсайти, що спрямовуватимуть наші рішення щодо зростання, маркетингу й продукту.

Chillio — це wellbeing-платформа, що допомагає формувати здорові звички, піклуватися про себе, краще розуміти свої емоції, підтримувати фокус і досягати цілей — легко та в ігровій формі.

Наш продукт включає web (PWA), iOS та Android застосунки, тому важлива синхронізація функціоналу між платформами та тісна співпраця з крос-функціональними командами.

Твої задачі: 

- Відповідати за весь цикл маркетингової аналітики — від необроблених даних до прийняття рішень

- Створювати та масштабувати потоки даних для ефективного маркетингу у всіх платних каналах

- Відповідати за маркетингові інформаційні панелі з детальним розбиттям за рекламними матеріалами та джерелами трафіку для відстеження та оптимізації LTV, CAC, ROAS та конверсії у воронці продажів

- Розробляти та автоматизувати моделі LTV, аналіз когорт та атрибуцію доходів по всіх каналах

- Тісно співпрацювати з маркетинговою командою для оптимізації розподілу бюджету, стратегій масштабування та ефективності каналів

- Підтримувати та оцінювати маркетингові експерименти (креативи, воронки, аудиторії, A/B-тести)

- Забезпечувати точну атрибуцію та узгодженість даних у всіх точках контакту з маркетингом та продуктом

Що очікуємо від тебе: 

- 2+ роки та більше досвіду роботи на посаді Data Analyst, Data Engineer, або на аналогічній посаді у сфері веб-маркетингу чи аналітики продуктів;

- Впевнене практичне володіння мовою SQL та досвід роботи з великими масивами даних;

- Глибоке розуміння показників ефективного маркетингу (CAC, LTV, ROAS, термін окупності);

- Досвід проведення когортного аналізу, моделювання LTV та прогнозування доходів;

- Досвід роботи з Tableau для створення інформаційних панелей та візуалізації даних;

Чому це крута пропозиція? 

- Повний ownership і широка зона впливу : це роль першої людини у функції, яка матиме реальну відповідальність за напрям і можливість формувати підхід майже з нуля.

- Перспектива масштабування команди : у майбутньому ця позиція може вирости в побудову власної аналітичної команди та ролі Ліда.

- Готова аналітична інфраструктура : у компанії вже є необхідна база — таблиці, дашборди та налагоджені процеси, тож не доведеться витрачати час на побудову всього з нуля.

- Фокус на аналітиці, а не технічному супроводі : за пайплайни даних відповідає окрема команда КМА, тому аналітик не займається дебагінгом, а працює як внутрішній замовник і партнер для бізнесу.

- Баланс стартап-динаміки та структури : компанія поєднує гнучкість і швидкість стартапу зі зрілим, добре організованим середовищем.

- Вплив на ключові бізнес-рішення : ця роль дає можливість не просто готувати звіти, а безпосередньо впливати на рішення компанії через дані, висновки та інсайти.

Ми пропонуємо: 

1. Формат роботи на твій вибір: fully remote з будь-якої точки вільного світу, а також доступ до одного з наших офісів за бажанням (Київ, Варшава).

3. Кар’єрне зростання через дію: 80%+ усіх leads в Kiss My Apps ще 2-3 роки тому були світчерами. Твій вплив тут не визначається роками в резюме — він визначається тим, як швидко ти навчаєшся, береш відповідальність та береш оунершіп за власну карʼєру.
4. Командні активності: Для підтримки ментального здоров’я нашої команди ми пропонуємо онлайн-заняття йогою двічі на тиждень.
5. Розвиток та професійна реалізація: проводимо внутрішні speaking clubs англійською з нейтів спікером, а також надаємо можливість виступати на внутрішніх та зовнішніх івентах від Kiss My Apps. Крім цього ти матимеш річний бюджет на покриття до 50% професійних конференції, освітніх подій та івентів.
6. Додаткові бенефіти, де ти обираєш: надаємо фіксований бюджет на рік з якого ти сам обираєш, яку статтю витрат покрити: 50% від медстрахування, психотерапії, спорту чи стоматології. А також 40 днів оплачуваного відпочинку та лікарняних без привʼязки до дат.

title: Senior DevOps / Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote Island Lake Argyle, Remote, 6743 Australia

A Senior DevOps / Infrastructure Engineer in this role is responsible for building, optimizing, and maintaining a high‑performance, secure, and globally distributed infrastructure. The position requires deep expertise in Linux systems, networking, monitoring, VPN technologies, and traffic‑evasion techniques used in modern privacy‑focused environments. 

About the Role 

You will design and operate mission‑critical infrastructure that supports large‑scale, high‑load systems. The work goes far beyond container management: it involves kernel‑level tuning, advanced networking, VPN stack engineering, and building monitoring systems from the ground up. This is a role for someone who understands how systems behave under pressure and knows how to automate everything that repeats. 

Key Responsibilities 

- Develop and evolve infrastructure architecture to ensure stability, scalability, and high availability. 

- Build and automate CI/CD pipelines using GitLab, Ansible, and Terraform. 

- Maintain and optimize Linux systems for high‑load environments, including kernel tuning and network performance adjustments. 

- Configure and improve monitoring systems (Zabbix, Grafana), including custom templates, auto‑discovery, and alerting logic. 

- Manage and optimize VPN technologies such as StrongSwan, OpenVPN, and Xray. 

- Analyze complex incidents, identify root causes, and implement long‑term fixes. 

- Ensure infrastructure security through access control, firewall management, updates, and 2FA. 

- Collaborate with development and QA teams in a distributed environment. 

- Participate in architectural decisions and guide the team through best practices. 

Core Skills and Expertise 

Monitoring Engineering 

- Advanced proficiency with Zabbix and Grafana , including: 

- custom templates, 

- auto‑discovery rules, 

- external scripts, 

- alerting pipelines, 

- performance dashboards. 

Linux & Kernel Optimization 

- Deep understanding of kernel and OS tuning for high‑load systems: 

- network I/O optimization, 

- socket buffer tuning, 

- IRQ affinity and CPU interrupt balancing, 

- NIC queue configuration, 

- sysctl tuning for throughput and latency. 

VPN Technologies 

- Hands‑on experience configuring and optimizing: 

- StrongSwan (IPsec) , 

- OpenVPN , 

- Xray-core (VLESS/REALITY, VMess, Shadowsocks). 

- Understanding how VPN protocols behave under different network conditions and censorship environments. 

DPI Evasion & Traffic Obfuscation 

- Knowledge of DPI/TSPU architecture and modern circumvention techniques: 

- domain fronting, 

- SNI masking, 

- ECH (Encrypted Client Hello), 

- REALITY, 

- uTLS fingerprinting. 

- Familiarity with obfuscation protocols such as Shadowsocks‑2022, Trojan‑GFW, and Cloak. 

Additional Technical Areas 

- Scripting: Bash, sed, awk; Go or Python for tooling and automation. 

- Virtualization: Proxmox, Docker, Portainer. 

- Networking: firewalls (nftables/iptables), routing, PBR, VLANs, GRE/IPIP tunnels, tun/tap, veth, bridges. 

- Databases: PostgreSQL or MySQL (schema design, optimization, replication basics). 

- Automation: Ansible, Terraform. 

- Cloud: AWS, Cloudflare, Hetzner. 

- Logging: Elastic Stack, OpenSearch, Vector, Promtail, Loki. 

- Kubernetes on bare metal: deployment, CNI, storage, operations. 

- Secrets management: Infisical. 

Who Thrives in This Role 

- Engineers who understand systems deeply and enjoy solving complex infrastructure problems. 

- People who automate everything and dislike repetitive manual work. 

- Those who can take ownership of critical systems and support the team with expertise. 

- Individuals comfortable working in distributed teams and communicating clearly in English. 

What the Company Offers 

- Fully remote, full‑time position with weekends off. 

- Work with international, high‑impact projects. 

- Opportunities for professional growth and specialization. 

- Competitive salary based on experience. 

- A young, friendly, and technically strong team.

title: Product Manager, Agent Harness & Modelling
description:

Who are we?

We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI.

Join us on our mission and shape the future!

About Cohere and North 

Cohere is revolutionizing enterprise AI with North, an agentic AI platform designed to securely deploy AI agents and automations within organizations' infrastructure. North empowers employees to streamline workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and unlock actionable insights while ensuring data privacy and compliance. North combines cutting-edge generative and search models with customizable integrations to drive productivity and innovation at scale.

Role Overview 

We are seeking an Agent Harness Product Manager to own the execution layer that makes North agents reliable, capable, and production-ready. This is a role that sits at the intersection of three domains:

- Agent Loop and Execution: Own the core agent runtime: tool orchestration, parallel execution, sub-agent delegation, sandbox code execution, and failure recovery. You will define how North agents plan and act across long, multi-step workflows and ensure the execution environment is robust enough for the most demanding enterprise tasks. You are expected to engage at the implementation level, contributing to architecture decisions alongside engineering rather than simply handing off requirements.

- Context Engineering: Own how our Agents manage the context window as a deliberately controlled resource. This includes progressive disclosure of tools and skills, context compaction and summarization, offloading of large payloads to a persistent filesystem, and the instrumentation that keeps agents oriented across extended trajectories.

- Model-Scaffolding Co-evolution: Own the feedback loop between North's harness and the Modeling Team. This PM is the connective tissue that makes that possible: ensuring harness design decisions are validated by Modeling before they are built, that evals are the shared bridge between both teams, and that as the harness evolves the model evolves with it.

Responsibilities 

- Define and own the roadmap for North's agent harness, including the agent loop, context engineering layer, tool orchestration, sandbox execution, and sub-agent delegation

- Serve as the primary interface between North engineering and Cohere's Modeling team, ensuring new harness capabilities are validated before being built and that neither team paints itself into a corner

- Own North's agentic evaluation framework, ensuring evals are compatible with both the North harness and Modeling's training infrastructure, and that they serve as a reliable bridge between product and research

- Engage enterprise customers to surface real-world agentic failures and translate findings into concrete product and model requirements

- Stay current with the open-source and commercial agent ecosystem and drive adoption decisions that keep North's architecture aligned with emerging standards.

Requirements 

- 5+ years of product management experience in agentic AI systems, developer infrastructure, or applied ML products

- Deep understanding of modern LLM agent architectures, including multi-agent systems, tool-augmented reasoning, memory and retrieval, programmatic orchestration, RAG, and long-horizon execution

- Strong grasp of agentic evaluation design, including how to measure task completion, failure recovery, and long-horizon reliability, and how to diagnose model vs. scaffolding gaps

- Technically deep enough to contribute to architecture decisions at the implementation level: comfortable reviewing and shaping design docs, reasoning about async execution patterns, sandboxed environments, filesystem design, and the tradeoffs that come with building harness capabilities into a production platform

- Ability to flex between ML research conversations and engineering architecture discussions with equal fluency

- Track record of shipping platform-layer products with demonstrated impact on reliability, performance, or capability.

Nice-to-Haves 

- An active practitioner of agent frameworks who regularly builds with and follows the latest developments in open-source harnesses, coding agents, and orchestration tools in both professional and personal work

- Hands-on experience with enterprise agentic deployments: multi-tenant orchestration, tool permissioning, audit trails, and compliance requirements

- Familiarity with infrastructure constraints relevant to enterprise deployments: on-premises environments, scalability challenges, and the operational tradeoffs of running complex agent workloads in restricted or air-gapped settings

- Prior work at the intersection of research and product, translating nascent model capabilities into shipped product features

- Background working within or closely alongside an ML research or post-training team

Why Join Cohere? 

- Impact: Shape how Canada's most important public institutions adopt and deploy frontier AI.

- You thrive in startups. You ship daily, adapt when priorities shift, and don't wait to be told what to own

Preferred skills

- Hands-on compliance work (SOC 2 or HIPAA) in a regulated industry like fintech, healthcare, or government

- Define vision & portfolio strategy. Own the long-term vision and multi-quarter roadmap for in-store voice AI and the platform that enables multiple use cases across FOH/BOH. Balance short-term pilots with long-term platform investments.

- Run vendor & technical evaluation. Lead technical evaluation of voice and AI vendors (ASR, NLU, TTS, edge inference, on-device options) and create benchmarking frameworks for accuracy, latency, privacy, and cost.

- Lead commercial conversations. Drive vendor commercial discussions (pricing models, licensing, SLAs) and surface negotiation points — partnering with Procurement and Legal who finalize contracts and budget approvals.

- Drive zero → one discovery and pilots. Plan and execute discovery, rapid prototyping, and in-restaurant pilots; iterate based on operational feedback and scale successful experiments.

- Design a reusable voice platform. Define APIs, integration patterns, data flows, and tooling that make voice capabilities reusable across guest experiences, staff workflows, and integrations with POS, kitchen systems, and telemetry services.

- Lead GTM & commercialization. Define pricing, packaging, and go-to-market strategy with Product Marketing, Sales, and Operations; identify commercial models that fit restaurants of different sizes.

- Coordinate cross-functional delivery. Align Engineering, Hardware Ops, Reliability, Security, Data, Research, Design, Care/Onboarding, and GTM partners to de-risk delivery and adoption.

- Drive operational readiness & reliability. Define operational playbooks, observability, edge/online failover modes, and post-launch monitoring to ensure reliable in-store behavior and low support cost.

- Champion field research & validation. Spend time in restaurants to learn operational workflows, validate prototypes, and iterate with real staff and guests.

- Mentor & shape product practice. Coach senior PMs and engineers on voice/AI product development, vendor evaluation, and responsible AI practices; contribute to the Product Playbook.

- Embrace and advocate for the use of AI tools to accelerate product discovery, streamline execution, and explore new product experiences - helping shape how we build and what we build. 

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements) 

- AI product delivery experience. ~8+ years shipping complex software products with demonstrated ownership of multi-team programs or a major product portfolio, and experience delivering AI-enabled features or products.

- AI Model Evaluation. Hands-on experience defining and owning AI model evaluation (examples: WER/CER, intent accuracy, wake-word false accept/reject, latency, completion/task success), building continuous evaluation and model ops processes (drift detection, automated regression tests, A/B testing, rollback/mitigation playbooks), and partnering with ML teams to run experiments and error analysis.

- Zero → one experience. Proven track record taking a product from discovery through prototype and pilot to scale.

- Vendor evaluation & commercial acumen. Hands-on experience evaluating AI/voice vendors and participating in vendor commercial conversations (note: Procurement/Legal finalize contracts).

- Platform mindset. Ability to design reusable APIs and platform capabilities that enable multiple downstream use cases and teams.

- Customer & ops empathy. Experience conducting on-site discovery and validating prototypes in operational environments (restaurant or other physical venues).

- Cross-team leadership. Exemplary stakeholder management and ability to align senior partners across hardware, engineering, ops, and GTM, especially on high-visibility initiatives.

- Communication & influence. Clear, persuasive written and verbal communication; able to synthesize technical tradeoffs and business value for executives and partners.

Special Sauce* (Nice to Haves) 

- Speech / voice product experience. Prior experience building voice AI products (ASR/NLU/TTS, or working directly with speech teams) is helpful but not required .

- Conversational UX & dialog design. Experience designing conversational flows, state management, turn-taking, error recovery and graceful degradation

- Exposure to hardware considerations for voice (far-field audio, beamforming, noise cancellation, embedded audio processing).

- Experience with on-device / edge inference and hybrid cloud/edge voice architectures (model quantization, latency/footprint tradeoffs).

- Familiarity with privacy, compliance, and PII handling for voice data (on-device vs cloud processing, country-level regulations).

- Background in restaurant, retail, or other physical-world operations .

- Experience with ML lifecycle tooling, continuous model evaluation, and production A/B testing strategies for AI features.

You’ll be measured on (suggested success metrics) 

- Launch and adoption of successful in-store voice pilots (pilot → scale conversion).

- Measurable operational impact (e.g., staff time saved, reduction in order errors, throughput gains).

- Guest experience improvements (NPS/CSAT lift for voice flows, voice take rate).

- Platform reuse (number of distinct use cases / teams reusing core voice APIs).

- Reliability & support outcomes (uptime targets, reduction in Care tickets related to voice).

- AI health & model performance: model accuracy (WER/intent accuracy), latency, drift rate, and rate of regressions caught by CI/monitoring systems.

AI at Toast 

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy 

We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. title: Product Designer
description:
Headquarters: Canada

Rockstar is recruiting for a digital product studio that specializes in turning ideas into extraordinary digital experiences. This client is a dynamic, remote-first team of savvy professionals known for pushing creative boundaries and delivering high-quality, user-centered products through a collaborative and lean approach.

This client is building a bench of talented product designers for upcoming client work. They are looking for mid-to-senior-level freelance designers who can bring strong UX thinking, sharp visual design skills, and a collaborative spirit to the team.

What they're looking for

If you're a seasoned product designer with a passion for digital excellence, this opportunity is for you. You’ve honed your craft over the years, with a deep understanding of UX design, visual storytelling, and collaborative product development.

You’re equally comfortable working independently and alongside a cross-functional team. You manage your time well, take ownership of your work, and make confident decisions with minimal oversight. You’re fluent in tools like Figma and Adobe Suite, and you bring a user-first mindset to everything you do — whether designing mobile apps or contributing to product strategy.

If you're the type of designer who pushes creative boundaries, communicates clearly, and still knows how to have a little fun in the process — they’d love to hear from you.

The Details

As a Product Design Contractor, you’ll contribute to a range of client-facing projects, collaborating with the Chief Creative Officer and team across the following areas:

- Digital Product Design (Web & App): Shape intuitive experiences by applying research, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs that elevate functionality and user engagement.

- User Research & Discovery: Conduct qualitative and quantitative research to inform feature planning and prioritization. Help build products grounded in real user needs and business goals.

- User Experience (UX): Apply UX methodologies like journey mapping, user flows, and usability testing to define products beyond UI — ensuring seamless and strategic user experiences.

- Visual Design: Lead visual direction on select projects, producing compelling layouts and assets that translate beautifully across platforms — from product to marketing.

- Presentation Collateral: Design high-impact presentation decks and visuals that bring ideas to life for clients and stakeholders.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with engineering and product teams by providing annotated designs, QA support, and input during handoff and development.

- Additional Design Support: Contribute to project-related needs like case studies, marketing assets, and content design for social media or internal documentation.

Qualifications

- 4–6 years of experience in product and visual design, with a strong focus on digital experiences across web and/or mobile

- Solid understanding of UX principles, including user research, usability testing, and translating insights into design decisions

- Demonstrated ability to own features or tracks of work with minimal oversight — from wireframes to high-fidelity execution

- Comfortable leading or contributing to discovery phases and helping define product direction in collaboration with strategy and engineering

- Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite, with experience working in a Mac environment

- Familiarity with remote collaboration tools such as Google Suite, Slack, Zoom, Jira, and Harvest

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a team-first mindset and the ability to clearly articulate design rationale

- Organized, proactive, and able to manage your own time in a fast-paced, remote work environment

- Bonus: experience working in client-facing or agency settings where flexibility, autonomy, and cross-functional teamwork are key

What to Expect from the Process

This is a contract-based role and part of an ongoing effort to build relationships with experienced designers for future client projects. Interviews are being conducted on a rolling basis, and while there may not be immediate openings, strong candidates will be added to the contractor roster and considered as new work becomes available.

Hiring timelines are directly tied to the sales pipeline, so project start dates vary. The team is committed to matching the right designer to the right project — and they will reach out when there’s a fit.

About the Client

This client is a digital product studio that brings together design, technology, and creativity to build meaningful experiences. They believe in pushing boundaries, working collaboratively, and delivering high-quality products that they are proud of.

The remote-first culture values autonomy, trust, and open communication. The team is always exploring new ideas, evolving their process, and building products that move the needle for their clients.

This position is remote and open to all candidates, but applicants based in New York City are prioritized for potential in-person collaboration.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote

URL: https://www.samsara.com/ 

About the role: 

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world. The platform processes 25+ trillion data points annually from IoT sensors, cameras, and connected devices across thousands of organizations, and that dataset is compounding: it grew from 4 trillion to 25+ trillion in four years. We're still early in turning that data into the products that will define how physical operations run, and we're hiring the engineers who will build what comes next.

We're approaching ~$2B ARR growing 30%+ year over year, with 96% of our largest customers on two or more products. The fastest-growing divisions at Samsara are tackling the hardest, most ambiguous problems at the company: building new products from scratch, applying AI and ML to massive real-world datasets, and shipping capabilities that change how organizations maintain equipment, manage fleets, and run day-to-day operations. Most of this work is zero-to-one, at billion-dollar scale.

We're looking for software engineers who want to define what ships next. Leveling is broad and flexible: we're hiring from Senior through Staff+, across platform and product, and we're open to shaping scope around the right person's strengths and interests. That window won't stay open long.

This role is remote and open to candidates residing in the US. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. 

You should apply if: 

- You want to impact the industries that run our world. The software you build will have real-world stakes: helping keep the lights on, getting food into grocery stores, keeping workers safe. What ships here isn't metrics on a dashboard. It shows up on the loading dock, the job site, and the dispatch floor.

- You want to build, not maintain. Samsara is in full growth mode. We're building new systems from scratch, not babysitting old ones. You'd own entire problem spaces end to end, with the autonomy to set direction from day one.

- You want to work where AI meets the physical world. Samsara has spent a decade building the largest proprietary dataset for physical operations. More connected assets generate more data, more data trains better models, better models drive more value, and more value wins more assets. The market and the opportunity here are what set us apart, not just the models.

- You believe customers are more than a number. Samsara engineers have a rare closeness to end users. You'll participate in customer interviews, collaborate with product managers and customer success, and use that context to build products that solve real problems operators face every day.

- You have the curiosity and drive to figure it out. We're looking for people who take pride in their work and get things done at all costs. The engineers who thrive here don't wait to be told what to build. They define it, ship it, and own the outcome. The rate-limiting step on our teams isn't tooling or process. It's ambition.

In this role, you will: 

- Take ownership of technically complex, mission-critical areas and run with them. We want to point you in a direction and show up to the demo meeting impressed, not spend our weeks managing the details.

- Define and drive technical strategy for new products and platform capabilities, from backend services and APIs to the customer-facing UI.

- Design and ship full-stack features end to end. You'll work across backend, frontend, and potentially mobile to deliver AI-powered products that solve real operational problems.

- Partner with product, design, and customer-facing teams to translate ambiguous, real-world problems into clear technical plans and measurable outcomes.

- Build and scale the systems behind AI-driven products, including data ingestion, APIs, and the workflows that put intelligence into the hands of operators.

- Raise the bar for the engineers around you through code reviews, design reviews, technical mentorship, and by setting a standard for quality, velocity, and craft.

- Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

- 8+ years of experience in software design and development, including building and operating production systems at scale.

- Strong full-stack fundamentals. You're comfortable working across backend services, APIs, and frontend (web or mobile) to ship complete products.

- Proficiency in modern languages and frameworks (Go, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, React, or similar).

- Demonstrated experience leading cross-team or cross-org projects from inception through rollout, including managing ambiguity, driving alignment, and delivering measurable impact.

- Experience building AI-powered or data-driven products. You don't need to train models, but you know how to take AI capabilities and turn them into products customers love.

- Strong communication skills and the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- A track record of building: zero-to-one products, systems you left in a meaningfully better place, or hard problems you refused to let stay unsolved.

An ideal candidate also has: 

- Experience shipping AI-powered features in production, whether that's LLM-based products, agentic workflows, recommendation systems, or other customer-facing AI.

- Comfort with modern AI-augmented development workflows (Cursor, LLMs, etc.) to multiply your output and accelerate delivery.

- Background working with real-world operational data (telematics, sensor data, work orders, inspections) or a strong interest in learning the domain.

- A proven track record of mentoring senior engineers and influencing engineering culture, standards, and best practices beyond a single team.

- Side projects, open-source contributions, or other signals of curiosity and drive outside the scope of your day job.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary

$162,400 — $290,000 USD

Total Rewards 

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara 

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Are you a driven back-end developer who doesn't wait for instructions, but is already thinking two steps ahead? Who experiments with new technologies and smart solutions alongside the job? Then we want to talk to you.

Straight forward but clear: Twikey isn't looking for someone to just execute. We're looking for someone who thinks, does and keeps going when the going gets tough. 

Because fintech is evolving at breakneck speed. That calls for real ownership and for someone who can dive deep on the technical side to keep innovating and improving our platform. You get plenty in return, such as the freedom and responsibility to deliver your own projects. Thanks in part to our organisational structure, you can shape your ideas in the short term and see the results of your hard work quickly.

Driven by your passion for building scalable, performant and secure back-end systems, you continuously raise the bar for your own skills and for our product.

As a member of our development team you work closely with our CTO, 3 fellow developers and 2 testers on the core of our software application. A small, strong team in which you take on a role with real impact on the future of our product.

- You focus on developing and improving the back-end of our platform, optimising the architecture and data processing while keeping the security and stability of our system in mind. This lets you put your technical skills to full use and come up with innovative solutions.

- With your expertise you'll make valuable suggestions and streamline processes for all our stakeholders, so we can work more efficiently and achieve better results.

- You provide technical support on integration projects with software houses, banks and large companies, solving complex technical problems. That gives you the chance to work on challenging projects and to get in touch with a wide range of technologies and industries.

Once you know our product inside out, there are plenty of challenging projects for you to help build.

What are we looking for in you?

- You are driven, curious and enterprising. Not only in your job, but outside of it too. You have a pro-active attitude and are always a few steps ahead: you spot opportunities, grab them and get to work.

- Technical challenges? You take them on, not because you have to, but because you want to learn . You're a self-starter and quickly get to grips with new technologies, languages or frameworks.

- You understand that a good product is never "finished". You draw energy from that mix of creating and fine-tuning . You think along, question things and keep building new solutions.

- You have experience using AI tools to build integrations. You're actively exploring how AI can contribute to smarter user experiences and more efficient software development. Experience with data analytics is an asset.

- You therefore attach a lot of importance to the security, stability and reliability of a system and know what it takes to get there. You work in a structured, meticulous way and write code that is clean, reusable and easy to test.

- You have demonstrable experience with Java, Go and the Spring framework . Experience with API integrations, web services, Linux or other relevant areas is a plus.

- You have a deep understanding of databases. You don't just know how to use them, you know how they work. You have an opinion on structured, high-quality code, architecture and back-end technologies.

- You have a very good command of English , for smooth collaboration with all colleagues and stakeholders. Dutch is an asset.

- You are based in a time zone within one hour of CET , so your working day overlaps with the team's for the daily stand-ups and close day-to-day collaboration.

- You can work independently and enjoy a small team where switching gears quickly, collaboration and knowledge sharing are central.

Twikey offers you:

- An environment where challenge, innovation and autonomy come first.

- The room to experiment, to challenge and to improve. And we expect you to really take that room.

- An ideal setting if you want to grow fast and healthily, both technically and personally. Training, ownership, taking on new or additional roles based on your talents and interests, ... a lot is possible here, and you're at the wheel!

- A complementary team of more than 35 colleagues who move forward together in a respectful and open atmosphere.

- A motivating workplace with plenty of knowledge and expertise , shared both formally during the daily stand-ups and the weekly Friday call, and informally at the coffee machine.

- Appreciation, openness and critical dialogue. Our Friction Hunter Trophy is an example: every month we celebrate the colleague who made the biggest difference for customers, teammates or internally. Your impact gets noticed!

- A modern workplace with different zones (conference, connect, co-work, concentrate) in a recently built, industrial-style office building. Easy to reach by car, by bike and by public transport on the edge of Ghent, right next to the KBC tower.

- A salary package tailored to your experience and skills, with plenty of extra-legal benefits, a collective bonus system and a cafeteria plan to convert your 13th month as you choose.

- The chance to work in an innovative Belgian fintech scale-up that is active in several countries, in a sector that is growing fast!

A job ad doesn't tell you everything. Our colleagues tell you here what it's really like to work at Twikey.

Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

The PDP Experience team is responsible for one of the highest traffic pages on the platform: the Comments page. We know that conversations are the lifeblood of Reddit, so we strive to ensure viewing content and the surrounding conversation is appealing, intuitive and delightful. This is a high impact role where you will drive related technical & product strategy, operations, architecture, and execution for one of the largest sites in the world.

What You’ll Do: 

- Work cross-functionally with product, design, and other engineering counterparts to execute on product and business strategy and build novel products and features that our users will love.

- Contribute to the full development cycle: technical design, development, test, experimentation, analysis, and launch. You’ll be reviewing code and design docs, giving feedback on product specs and mocks.

- Contribute meaningfully to team strategy. We give everyone a seat at the table and encourage active participation in planning for the future. Don’t just come along for the ride.

- Participate with a team of thoughtful, fast-moving, and motivated engineers. Contribute to standards that improve developer workflows, and recommend best practices.

- Move fast while balancing quality. We can’t afford extensive processes, and we also can’t afford show-stopping bugs. We need someone who can balance speed with quality while quickly building brand-new products.

- Continuously learn and improve your technical and non-technical abilities.

Who You Might Be: 

- BS degree in Computer Science, a similar technical field of study or equivalent practical experience

- Minimum of 3+ years of post-internship, full-time, hands-on, professional software development experience in large-scale distributed systems. 

- 3+ years of software development experience in one or more general-purpose programming languages; Go, Python, Rust, Ruby.

- Experienced with GraphQL, REST, HTTP, Thrift or gRPC basics, and the ability to design and implement maintainable APIs.

- Strong organizational skills, the ability to prioritize tasks and keep projects on schedule.

- Entrepreneurial spirit. You are self-directed, innovative, and biased towards action in fast-paced environments. You love to build new things and thrive in ambiguity and even failure.

- Excellent communication skills. You collaborate effectively with teams in a fully remote environment and discuss complex topics with technical and non-technical audiences.

Benefits: 

- Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs

- 401k with Employer Match

- Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support

- Family Planning Support

- Gender-Affirming Care

- Mental Health & Coaching Benefits

- Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off

- Generous Paid Parental Leave 

Pay Transparency: 

This job posting may span more than one career level.

In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit https://www.redditinc.com/careers/ .

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, skills, depth of work experience and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below.

The base salary range for this position is:

$164,000 — $229,000 USD 

In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews.

During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable. We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes. We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision. For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors . 

Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve. Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know. 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/reddit-backend-software-engineer-pdp-experience

title: Proxybase | Backend Systems Engineer (Rust) | Remote, Global | Full-Time Hi HN,
description:
Proxybase | Backend Systems Engineer (Rust) | Remote, Global | Full-Time Hi HN,
I’m the founder of Proxybase [0]. We’re building a SOCKS5 proxy network focused on transparency and ethical sourcing in the residential proxy market.
A quick note for anyone who applied last month: thank you to everyone who reached out. We received far more strong applications than expected, and between running day-to-day operations and working through the backlog, we took much longer to reply than we should have.
If you applied last month and haven’t heard back yet, I’m sorry for the delay. We’re actively reviewing those applications alongside this new batch. Why Proxybase?
The residential proxy industry has a rough history. Some providers rely on hidden background scrapers bundled into TV firmware or mobile apps, while others use payout systems that can hold provider funds for months. We’re trying to build something better:
Open-source clients: Our GUI [1] and CLI [2] are fully open source, so anyone can inspect and audit what runs on their device.
Explicit consent: Providers knowingly opt in. No stealth bundling.
Fair, fast payouts: The minimum payout is $1, sent directly to provider wallets in USD stablecoins. We do not hold funds to earn interest on them. We’re hiring a Backend Systems Engineer with Rust experience to help build: Asynchronous SOCKS5 routing infrastructure,
Daemon and node orchestration,
Automated bandwidth-allocation pipelines Stack: Rust, Tokio, Axum, SOCKS5, Linux systemd daemons, SQLite Location: Fully remote, async-friendly, flexible time zones
Compensation: Competitive salary plus equity. USD or stablecoin payment options are available. If you’re interested in building infrastructure for an industry that needs better standards, email jobs@proxybase.xyz with your GitHub, résumé, and a short note about what you’ve been working on recently. I’ll also be around in the comments to answer questions and hear feedback. [0]: https://proxybase.xyz [1]: https://github.com/proxybasehq/proxybase-gui [2]: https://github.com/proxybasehq/proxybase-cli

title: Cardog | Toronto, Canada or REMOTE | Full-time
description:
Cardog | Toronto, Canada or REMOTE | Full-time
https://cardog.app/careers We're the system of record for the Canadian vehicle: raw automotive data turned into facts that can be checked. Our open-source VIN decoder sits underneath a government vehicle registry. Some of what's interesting: - A government registry, a manufacturer's own filing, a listing site and an insurance record will describe the same truck four different ways, and nothing in any of those files says they're the same truck. Reconciling that, for every vehicle in the country, in a way that holds up when a regulator asks how you know, is most of the data work. - Seventeen characters on a door frame encode manufacturer, plant, model year and build attributes — badly, inconsistently, and differently per manufacturer. Public reference data covers some of it. The rest gets worked out from filings, recall documents, and patterns inferred across millions of vehicles. - We read vehicles directly over OBD-II now. Forty modules answered on a recent Hyundai, each reporting its own part number and installed software version. Nothing downstream of the VIN moves when a module is reflashed, so no registration, history report or dealer system knows what software is actually in a car. Hiring: VIN Decode Engineer, Data Platform Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer, Founding Engineer (dealer platform). TypeScript, Postgres, Cloudflare Workers. Full descriptions and apply: https://cardog.app/careers
